nodes.rationale: 分层是主题化的接缝：暗色/白标/高对比变体只重指 semantic 层，primitives 与组件 CSS 不动；组件里直接用 --blue-500 的库没有主题接缝，后补等于审计每个用法。无角色的阶不生成、status 只发真实渲染的，从生成侧抑制 token 膨胀。

nodes.label: 逻辑属性替代表与 RTL 镜像纪律
nodes.norm_label: 逻辑属性替代表与 rtl 镜像纪律
nodes.rationale: 用 leading/trailing 思考替代 left/right，消除一整类方向性 bug 的维护成本；技能自带的 C1 保留条款声明所有数值只是「无既有密度/间距体系时的起点」，项目既有 token 权威高于技能默认值，防止把 12/16/24px 变成僵硬普世标准。

nodes.label: 共享五列 review 输出契约（Severity/Location/Before/After/Why + Verification + Verdict）
nodes.norm_label: 共享五列 review 输出契约(severity/location/before/after/why + verification + verdict)
nodes.rationale: better-colors / better-layout / better-typography / better-ui / better-accessibility 的 review-output 结构完全同构（同一五列表、同一 Severity 与 Block/Needs changes/Approve 词汇表），应提取为单一契约 + 各领域 Severity 定义补丁，而不是复制多份拷贝；被 better-interface 编排时格式/严重度/合并/上限/裁决归上层。

nodes.label: 角色化字阶（每阶绑定 size + line-height + weight）
nodes.norm_label: 角色化字阶(每阶绑定 size + line-height + weight)
nodes.rationale: 一个角色一次决策而非三次（产品界面起点：Display 36/1.1/600 … Caption 13/1.4/400）；按用途命名而非按尺寸，与 better-colors 的 semantic token 层同构；配「用项目自己的惯用法写修复」把统一性延伸为不引入第二套样式体系。

nodes.label: Better UI 16 条数值处方（同心圆角 / 阴影代边框 / 可中断动画 / scale 0.96 / 图标描边-字重映射）
nodes.norm_label: better ui 16 条数值处方(同心圆角 / 阴影代边框 / 可中断动画 / scale 0.96 / 图标描边-字重映射)
nodes.rationale: 把嵌套半径（outer = inner + padding）、图标描边与文字字重映射等从感觉变成可算规则，且多数可机器检查（transition-all 禁令、will-change 白名单、currentColor 单 SVG 按态变色、scale 不得低于 0.95）；零脚本零依赖，是 P0 中移植成本最低的一个，另带一套 10% 速度回放评审方法。

nodes.label: Impeccable 有界验证（一轮批式检查 + 最多一次确认轮，两轮上限）
nodes.norm_label: impeccable 有界验证(一轮批式检查 + 最多一次确认轮,两轮上限)
nodes.rationale: build fully → 一次批式检查（web 上 desktop+mobile 同轮）→ 一批修完 → 最多再一轮确认 → 停止打磨；开放式 self-QA 被明确定性为烧钱行为，为 workflowhub 的 QA 迭代设上限协议。

nodes.label: Impeccable Craft Floor（Verify 9 条 + Refuse 20 条质量地板）
nodes.norm_label: impeccable craft floor(verify 9 条 + refuse 20 条质量地板)
nodes.rationale: 编辑 UI 前必载的绝对禁令：对比度 4.5:1/3:1、行长 65–75ch、display ≤6rem、字距下限 -0.04em、禁嵌套卡片、禁 kicker（唯一无 brief 可挣回项）、elevation 只声明一次。地板只管机械不管方向 — 全绿后把页面花在承诺的世界上，纠结时 commit。

nodes.label: detect.mjs 确定性反模式检测器（约 58 条注册规则，exit 0=clean / 2=有发现）
nodes.norm_label: detect.mjs 确定性反模式检测器(约 58 条注册规则,exit 0=clean / 2=有发现)
nodes.rationale: 规则覆盖 AI 审美聚集色板、字体黑名单、kicker/编号标签、嵌套卡片与 design-system-* 漂移检测；定位是缺陷证据而非质量证明（须逐条在上下文中核实、标出误报），机械事实可采集但不构成推进许可证。

nodes.label: Impeccable 双独立子代理评审（A 设计评审 / B 检测器证据）+ Nielsen 0–4 打分
nodes.norm_label: impeccable 双独立子代理评审(a 设计评审 / b 检测器证据)+ nielsen 0–4 打分
nodes.rationale: A 与 B 必须作为两个隔离子代理并行，且 A 先完成、detector 发现才进父合成上下文以防锚定；inline 单上下文运行即降级，报告首行必须挂 ⚠️ DEGRADED 横幅 — 沉默降级=失败评审。这条直接呼应 workflowhub 宪法「质量裁决由独立来源在独立上下文产出，禁止自审自判」与「provider 失败不得改写为质量通过」。

nodes.label: 删除侧信号路由表（- 侧线索 → owner 技能，含等价替换白名单）
nodes.norm_label: 删除侧信号路由表(- 侧线索 → owner 技能,含等价替换白名单)
nodes.rationale: 信号是线索不是发现：删除只有在变更中无替代时才是回归，判断归领域技能；路由前先查等价替换清单（aria-label→labelledby、outline→box-shadow 焦点环、物理属性→逻辑属性、字符串移入翻译目录），否则报告会装满实为重构的「回归」。

nodes.label: 变更范围解析与爆炸半径扩展（merge-base 优先 / 一跳两跳 / 最多 5 个消费者）
nodes.norm_label: 变更范围解析与爆炸半径扩展(merge-base 优先 / 一跳两跳 / 最多 5 个消费者)
nodes.rationale: 解析顺序是硬规则：先查工作区会让一个游荡的格式化编辑遮蔽 12 个 commit 的分支；无变更时禁止自行退回 HEAD~1..HEAD（最后 commit 常是 merge 或别人的工作）而应陈述事实并给三条路线。无界扫描产出无法支撑的覆盖声明，故须声明未扩展的消费者数量。

nodes.norm_label: 三态发现分类(introduced / regression / pre-existing)
nodes.rationale: 按 diff 触及的行而非所在文件分类（未触及的行即使离 hunk 三行也是 Pre-existing，必要时 git blame 对 base ref 确认），使「本次变更引入的债」与历史债分离、Pre-existing 不背锅；回归在变更后状态中不可见，所以必须读 diff 的 - 侧。

nodes.norm_label: workflowhub and multica responsibility boundary
nodes.rationale: WorkflowHub owns host-independent stages, evidence, handoff, verification, and close; Multica owns orchestration, Issues, mentions, statuses, and configuration without becoming a WorkflowHub runtime dependency.

nodes.label: review as quality fact, not gate
nodes.norm_label: review as quality fact, not gate
nodes.rationale: Review verdicts, provider failures, and unavailable states remain observable facts; they do not become an endless pass-seeking loop or a new public runtime gate.

nodes.label: append-only recovery paths
nodes.norm_label: append-only recovery paths
nodes.rationale: Runner replacement and Phase pointer recovery are separate append-only paths: old formal records remain unchanged, gates are independently consumed, and official existing entry points resume work after recovery.

nodes.label: atomic gate and pointer CAS
nodes.norm_label: atomic gate and pointer cas
nodes.rationale: A successful reopen must atomically persist one recovery record, consume one gate, and flip the authoritative pointer; rejection, replay, conflict, or fault leaves the prior pointer and gate state intact.

nodes.norm_label: 需求→决定覆盖矩阵(23/23 covered,五维度标注)

nodes.norm_label: d-001 收敛治理三层总纲(机制→检查→收尾)

nodes.norm_label: d-003 spec-analyze 补目标达成与方案收敛维度

nodes.norm_label: d-005 build-spec clarify 判定标准写死

nodes.norm_label: d-009 dogfood 通过标准写死(只跑正常简单任务)

nodes.norm_label: adr-006 放开 verify-code 审查面并加宿主侧 conclusion 与 coverage

nodes.label: ADR-014 每条验收结论携带五类执行事实与证据形态分类
nodes.norm_label: adr-014 每条验收结论携带五类执行事实与证据形态分类

nodes.norm_label: adr-017 证据以具名路径对应、降级项必须有风险承接人

nodes.label: ADR-019 AC 判据唯一权威在 spec，decision-log 验收面只是交接索引

nodes.label: ADR-021 失败先分诊并补齐本仓自定的 Disposition 词表
nodes.norm_label: adr-021 失败先分诊并补齐本仓自定的 disposition 词表
nodes.rationale: IEEE 1044 样本没有 won't fix 取值，必须自己补，否则决定不修会变成不留痕的黑洞；标准只要求记录最终处置、不要求谁批，这块留白必须自己补。取不修的取值必须带理由与风险接受人署名。

nodes.label: ADR-022 card-06 越权删除回收与本任务同做，单独占一个普通 phase
nodes.norm_label: adr-022 card-06 越权删除回收与本任务同做,单独占一个普通 phase
nodes.rationale: 46 项里只有 23 项拿回、18 项部分拿回、5 项不拿回，说明三次删除提交越过了授权边界而当时没有任何检查发现；回收只以声明性文本或字段进行，不重建任何被删的机器校验器、认证、receipts 或哈希绑定。

nodes.label: ADR-023 用跨语言写作规则精炼所有文档输出物，不新增控制面
nodes.norm_label: adr-023 用跨语言写作规则精炼所有文档输出物,不新增控制面
nodes.rationale: decision-log 曾达 1,854 行、326,870 B，涨的是单行内容；用户要求精炼、高质量、好阅读、不丢失细节。与 ASD-STE100 冲突处一律以 ISO 24495-1 为准，只取跨语言通用规则，丢弃英文许可词表与字数句法硬上限，且明确不做自动校验器、评分器与阻断门。

nodes.label: ADR-024 make-decision 步骤按大纲重排为 15 步

nodes.label: ADR 0012 Current Materials Derived Publication
nodes.norm_label: adr 0012 current materials derived publication
nodes.rationale: The decision is hard to reverse, future readers would otherwise wonder why historical mechanisms no longer participate in current runs, and it is a genuine trade-off between auditable history and low complexity - all three ADR conditions hold. The ADR supersedes ADR 0005/0008/0009/0011 and the relevant parts of ADR 0007/0002 while keeping deterministic identity, historical bytes, independent review and severe-finding handling.

nodes.label: Four Current Materials Are the Working Truth
nodes.norm_label: four current materials are the working truth
nodes.rationale: Multiple current selectors (requirements pointer, accepted checkpoint, reopen/rebind/recovery/reset) conflict; reusing the single existing task-material-revision.v1 and leaving history read-only keeps one current state while preserving old bytes and hashes for audit.

nodes.label: Per-Deletion Proof Card and Vertical Slices
nodes.norm_label: per-deletion proof card and vertical slices
nodes.rationale: Deletion risk cannot be judged from file names, so each candidate proves consumer/reverse references, preserved quality semantics, replacement path, the same negative oracle before and after, fault injection, Multica compatibility and a rollback commit. Missing any item means KEEP. The proof card stays an ordinary build-plan/build-code task field - it must never become a new state machine.

nodes.label: Direction Review Finding F-6bf98330c313
nodes.norm_label: direction review finding f-6bf98330c313
nodes.rationale: The direction review verdict revise_required is preserved unchanged; the finding showed the original plan demanded per-item proof without defining a single recomputable deletion proof, so the repair added the proof card, vertical deletion slices, negative oracle, fault injection, Multica compatibility and rollback requirements.

nodes.label: Full File Inventory and Stable AGENTS.md Rules
nodes.norm_label: full file inventory and stable agents.md rules
nodes.rationale: A full tracked-file inventory (KEEP/MOVE/MERGE/DELETE/GENERATE/ARCHIVE) surfaces orphans, while AGENTS.md records only stable directory responsibilities and dependency direction so the rules do not drift the way a per-file list would.

nodes.label: Quality Facts Append-Only, Publication Derived
nodes.norm_label: quality facts append-only, publication derived
nodes.rationale: Review, test, confirmation and authorization facts are worth keeping as original bytes, but turning them into work permits let old heads lock business tasks. Publication recomputes from current materials and facts once, satisfying both append-only audit and normal revision; completion predicates must stay few, direct and failable so derived logic cannot silently pass.

nodes.label: Tests Converge to Quality Predicates and Fault Injection
nodes.norm_label: tests converge to quality predicates and fault injection
nodes.rationale: Deleting the state machines removes their combination space, so tests are designed against external quality predicates instead: five-stage E2E, material revision, severe findings, canonical write failure, legacy read-only/import and Skill Bundle clean-install. Every test deletion must be bound to a deleted capability and a replacement oracle, because a wrongly deleted unique oracle is the main risk.

nodes.label: Multica Skill Bundle vs Local Runner Release
nodes.norm_label: multica skill bundle vs local runner release
nodes.rationale: Multica only consumes stages and skills, so it needs the minimal runnable skill package; tests, history migration and dependency install belong to the Runner repo. node_modules is not committed and not bundled - only the lockfile installs it locally or in CI - which shrinks the Multica install surface without sacrificing local formal verification.

nodes.label: Clean-Install Read-Only Runner Verification
nodes.norm_label: clean-install read-only runner verification
nodes.rationale: Business tasks run through a clean-install read-only Runner in a Mutica-like empty directory, and tracked plus untracked content hashes of the WorkflowHub source tree must be identical before and after, proving the Hub is never modified to work around the Hub.

nodes.label: DEC-003 Delete and Move Separation
nodes.norm_label: dec-003 delete and move separation
nodes.rationale: Tidy directories can mask mechanisms that still exist, so vertical deletion happens in Phase 5 and mechanical directory movement only in Phase 8; each behaviour change stays independently provable and revertible, and a KEEP slice does not block other proven slices.

nodes.label: DeletionProof Contract
nodes.norm_label: deletionproof contract
nodes.rationale: Fields are consumer, quality_semantic, replacement, before_after_oracle, fault_injection, Multica, legacy, rollback and user_decision, held as ordinary plan/evidence fields with no lifecycle state, so the proof itself cannot regrow into a state machine.

nodes.label: Twelve Vertical Deletion Slices DEL-01..DEL-12
nodes.norm_label: twelve vertical deletion slices del-01..del-12
nodes.rationale: Each slice runs RED (prove the old entry is still reachable) then GREEN (delete grill replacement, phase trace lineage, dedicated invalidation, continuation, rebind, reopen, stage recovery, recovery/reset workspace CAS, duplicate projection, transition journal, shadow checkpoints, obsolete tools). A slice whose proof is incomplete or still has consumers is explicitly KEEP - KEEP is not failure and deleting to hit a count is forbidden; every GREEN keeps its own diff, evidence and revert boundary.

nodes.label: Two Human Gates T021 and T056
nodes.norm_label: two human gates t021 and t056
nodes.rationale: T021 confirms the planned deletion list before any irreversible removal and T056 confirms the actual deletions and diff at the end; commit, push, close and worktree deletion remain separately authorized, so plan confirmation can never be read as Git permission.

nodes.label: LegacyImport Model
nodes.norm_label: legacyimport model
nodes.rationale: Accepts only the spec FR-LEG-001 minimal format (source schema/hash, task identity, four materials, requirements, original facts) and rejects unknown, conflicting, corrupt or dual-write-demanding shapes; identical input yields identical identity.

nodes.label: MaterialRevision Data Model
nodes.norm_label: materialrevision data model
nodes.rationale: The single current revision of the four materials plus requirements ledger/coverage records parent_ref/hash, the four material refs and hashes, changed files and source, and is create-only with CAS. It must not decide tests, review or formal completion.

nodes.label: Per-File Inventory and Deletion Plan Tools
nodes.norm_label: per-file inventory and deletion plan tools
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 generates a recomputable inventory, complexity baseline and deletion-proof contract before any production capability is removed; every tracked file must land in exactly one disposition and the 12 candidates must carry a proof status, with baseline numbers recomputed from the current tree rather than inherited from the downloaded plan.

nodes.label: Requirement and Verification Traceability Matrix
nodes.norm_label: requirement and verification traceability matrix
nodes.rationale: Every FR maps to task IDs, AC IDs, phases and an owning gate/evidence, and the original dictated requirements plus the downloaded plan are audited so each item lands in spec, phase, task and an executable gate; the audit concludes that the downloaded plan's historical 30-day/one-release compatibility window is explicitly overridden by later dictation - no compatibility period, and unsafe handling is a STOP.

nodes.label: Seven-Behavior Public Runtime Facade
nodes.norm_label: seven-behavior public runtime facade
nodes.rationale: CLI stable behaviors are fixed at doctor/status/run/review/verify/confirm/authorize, shrinking the public cognitive surface while reusing TaskHandle and wh-review. The risk is a long-lived dual-track wrapper, so Phase 5 must delete the old entry points.

nodes.label: Test Strategy: 3 E2E, 5 Mutations, Writer Fault Matrix
nodes.norm_label: test strategy: 3 e2e, 5 mutations, writer fault matrix
nodes.rationale: Three synthetic E2E scenarios (normal execution with unchanged Hub source, mid-task material revision plus severe-finding repair, idempotent resume after write interruption or unavailable review) plus five deliberate breakage samples (identity/tree/hash misbinding, missing completion, review unavailable or severe finding, confirmation-vs-authorization confusion, Bundle closure pollution) must all go red when the protection is broken. Behaviors are RED=1 on the behavior gate, paired GREEN=0, non-behavior gates=0, and mechanisms are deleted before their dedicated tests.

nodes.label: Final Three-Provider Architecture Review
nodes.norm_label: final three-provider architecture review
nodes.rationale: Phase 9 runs clean install, the full quality matrix and a formal three-party architecture review through the official wh-review seam with providers fixed at kimi/k3, claude-code/opus and cursor/grok; if no aggregate semantic verdict forms, the canonical unavailable attempt and its diagnosis stay as audit facts and the verify summary states incomplete - never pass, never a fallback bridge, and historical provider trees are never work permits.

nodes.label: TaskHandle Atomic Writers and Writer Cutover
nodes.norm_label: taskhandle atomic writers and writer cutover
nodes.rationale: TaskHandle keeps nofollow/create-only/CAS safety semantics; the cutover to the single new writer must be atomic, with the old writer remaining the only production writer until the full fault matrix (temp write, fsync, rename, CAS, current pointer) and concurrent single-winner idempotency are proven. If unprovable, the task STOPS rather than adding a sixth persistent object family.

nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria AC-01..AC-15
nodes.norm_label: acceptance criteria ac-01..ac-15
nodes.rationale: Each AC names its requirements, verification method, pass condition, failure condition and evidence type, so acceptance is machine-checkable; AC-06 and AC-07 bind deletion proof, AC-08 binds legacy zeroing, AC-10/AC-11 bind distribution compatibility and AC-12/AC-14 bind anti-fragile test and non-blocking complexity reporting.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking Complexity Budget FR-MET-001
nodes.norm_label: non-blocking complexity budget fr-met-001
nodes.rationale: Build and verify produce one recomputable static complexity report without adding a runtime metrics system: test lines 12k warning, focused tests 15s cap, full tests 120s cap, public Runner behaviors cap 8, schemas cap 10, persistent object families cap 5, single core file cap 1000 lines, production code cap 15k lines. Overshoot is reported with actual/target/delta and hot spots and never alone fails the delivery, while recovery-state zero, dual-write zero and Bundle-forbidden-content zero stay hard gates.

nodes.label: Derived Formal Publication from Current Facts
nodes.norm_label: derived formal publication from current facts
nodes.rationale: Continuing to work, having a structurally valid result and being good enough to complete are three independent judgements. File existence, a successful command, a provider exit or an old accepted record can never alone constitute completion, and any identity/hash/task/stage/tree/capability mismatch fails immediately rather than partially writing.

nodes.label: Skill Bundle and Runner Release Distribution
nodes.norm_label: skill bundle and runner release distribution
nodes.rationale: Skill Bundle is Multica's lightweight consumable and must exclude tests, dependency install directories, historical material, task evidence and host absolute paths; Runner Release independently declares its compatible interface so that a missing or incompatible Runner permits explanation and drafting but forbids formal records or claiming verify/close success.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Vertical Deletion
nodes.norm_label: evidence-driven vertical deletion
nodes.rationale: Deletion is premised on equivalent quality semantics, not on falling file or line counts; the zeroing list (dedicated recovery/reopen/rebind/continuation commands, stage-transition authority state, accepted checkpoint edit permits, stage recovery run/source, Grill replacement, phase trace lineage, duplicate fact projections and dual writers) must all reach 0, and no slice may commit without close authorization.

nodes.label: Legacy Task Import Proof and Immediate Exit
nodes.norm_label: legacy task import proof and immediate exit
nodes.rationale: Only a task-local offline importer is allowed; after frozen fixtures prove no content loss and idempotent repeat import, the reader/importer/schema/fixture are deleted inside the same task so legacy compatibility in final source, release package and public entry points is exactly 0. Dual-writing old and new formats is forbidden and any failed migration proof is a STOP.

nodes.label: Unified Current Material Revision
nodes.norm_label: unified current material revision
nodes.rationale: Four current materials plus the current code tree and one material revision are the basis for continued work; the requirements ledger and coverage bind to the same revision and lose their independent current pointers, so historical results can never act as a work permit while history stays read-only.

nodes.label: Multica Clean Install Scenario SCN-008
nodes.norm_label: multica clean install scenario scn-008
nodes.rationale: Given only a Skill Bundle and a declared-compatible Runner Release, installing into a clean target must resolve the Stage, Skill and review dependency closure completely; the Bundle contains no tests, dependency install directories, historical tasks or host absolute paths, and a missing compatible Runner forbids writing formal results.

nodes.label: Runner Contract Version Fields and Match Rule
nodes.norm_label: runner contract version fields and match rule
nodes.rationale: Bundle declares runner_contract_major (positive integer) and runner_contract_min_minor (nonnegative integer); Runner declares runner_contract_major and runner_contract_minor; major must be equal and the Runner minor must be at least the Bundle minimum, with missing fields, wrong types or mismatches all failing loud.

nodes.rationale: 把没做到/失败/未完成/未知/不可用逐条置顶，不能凭 P5 中途报告、计划文本、测试文件存在或某个绿色命令推断全卡质量合格；独立执笔者原样贴出，不自审自判；结构 GREEN 只证明报告合同，不等于业务通过。

nodes.norm_label: 复杂度基线 formal_test_lines 数字真相
nodes.rationale: published JSON 的 actual=20292 不实；改为 buildReport() 内存实测真值并按 actual-limit 重算倍数，同时把写死 within_limit=false 的断言换成逐字段真相断言并保留块外字节守卫。

nodes.norm_label: 阶段末报告事实层 stage-end-report-facts.v1

nodes.norm_label: append-only continuation 与 legacy 只读兼容

nodes.label: D1–D7 字面量更正 appendix (decision-correction-appendix.v1)
nodes.norm_label: d1–d7 字面量更正 appendix (decision-correction-appendix.v1)

nodes.label: decision-coverage-audit.v1 最终确认前逐条覆盖审计
nodes.norm_label: decision-coverage-audit.v1 最终确认前逐条覆盖审计
nodes.rationale: 必须在最终确认卡前生成；未映射且未明确接受的遗漏阻止确认，coverage status 保持 accepted_omission 而不伪造 covered。

nodes.label: decision-entry.v1 唯一决定条目 schema
nodes.norm_label: decision-entry.v1 唯一决定条目 schema

nodes.label: decision-log-contract.v1 恰好一次覆盖
nodes.norm_label: decision-log-contract.v1 恰好一次覆盖
nodes.rationale: accepted_decision_coverage 必须枚举每条来源并证明恰好覆盖一次：零次是遗漏、两次是重复，均失败。

nodes.label: 独立人类可读 decision-log.md + receipt ref/hash
nodes.norm_label: 独立人类可读 decision-log.md + receipt ref/hash
nodes.rationale: 选择 Markdown 主文件 + receipt 只存 ref/hash 合同事实，而非 receipt 内单字符串摘要：多一个 artifact，换来人工可读性与稳定 diff，同时下游只经 accepted decision_ref 读取最终版本。

nodes.label: decision-omission-acceptance.v1 专用遗漏接受
nodes.norm_label: decision-omission-acceptance.v1 专用遗漏接受
nodes.rationale: 与 review 的 risk-acceptance 分成两个 schema：两种风险对象与放行边界不同，混用会错误放行遗漏或结构错误。

nodes.label: 宿主独立性（无 Multica / Issue 身份 / cwd / root 注入）
nodes.norm_label: 宿主独立性(无 multica / issue 身份 / cwd / root 注入)
nodes.rationale: 核心保持宿主无关，组件只拿窄 capability；必须用中性宿主真实 harness 验证，纯正则扫描不算验收。

nodes.label: host-visible ask/reply ref 信任边界
nodes.norm_label: host-visible ask/reply ref 信任边界
nodes.rationale: host-visible ref 只证明消息投递到宿主可见表面，不证明作者是真人或用户已阅读；缺失、重复、跨轮或跨 run 复用全部失败。代理生成、默认值和自报不能替代真实 reply。

nodes.label: interaction-completion.v1 真实逐题交互记录
nodes.norm_label: interaction-completion.v1 真实逐题交互记录
nodes.rationale: 不保存完整问题卡原文，只保存 card hash、格式检查、选中项和 ask/reply/re-rank 顺序：在不落盘秘密与完整对话的前提下证明交互真实发生。

nodes.label: 风险驱动窄测试与 RED→GREEN 纪律
nodes.norm_label: 风险驱动窄测试与 red→green 纪律
nodes.rationale: 每个行为改动先用最窄 RED 证明缺陷再用同文件 GREEN；不默认运行全量测试，最终是否广覆盖由 T076 按实际风险单独说明，降低成本与等待。

nodes.label: 原 task 真实 revision 与处理组 1 重放
nodes.norm_label: 原 task 真实 revision 与处理组 1 重放
nodes.rationale: 只生成 replay 计划或恢复命令不算交付：必须在原 review-foundation-baseline task 上真实创建新 revision/attempt 并实际重放处理组 1，同时保留旧失败 attempt/review。

nodes.label: plan-task-contract.v1 可执行 plan/tasks 契约
nodes.norm_label: plan-task-contract.v1 可执行 plan/tasks 契约
nodes.rationale: Phase 六段、task 必填字段、命令/oracle、DAG 与 61 FR/53 AC 双向映射由确定性 validator 提供事实；provider pass 不能覆盖结构缺口。

nodes.label: 有限 review 成本策略（零 provider resolution / 一次结构 full）
nodes.norm_label: 有限 review 成本策略(零 provider resolution / 一次结构 full)
nodes.rationale: 普通文档修改不再次调用 provider；重大结构变化最多补一次完整审查；build-code 每次修复仍完整审查到 pass，避免重复花费同时不伪造 verdict。

nodes.label: review-delta-resolution.v1 零 provider 普通修改证明
nodes.norm_label: review-delta-resolution.v1 零 provider 普通修改证明
nodes.rationale: 只能由 TaskKernel 绑定并推进同一 flow，structural_change=false 且 provider_calls=0；不能伪造新 verdict，也不能用于 build-code 修复或重大结构变化。

nodes.label: TaskKernel 唯一 review flow/root/head/CAS 权威 (review-flow.v1)
nodes.norm_label: taskkernel 唯一 review flow/root/head/cas 权威 (review-flow.v1)

nodes.norm_label: risk-acceptance.v1 append-only 风险记录

nodes.norm_label: 宪法审查先于 rsk 实现的强制顺序

nodes.label: Material-only review preservation
nodes.norm_label: material-only review preservation
nodes.rationale: Material-only changes should preserve an already recorded review fact and avoid redispatch, while retaining the special verify-code snapshot guard.

nodes.label: Review-result deduplication
nodes.norm_label: review-result deduplication
nodes.rationale: Unchanged review requests should reuse immutable canonical results; only an explicitly judged retry should create a new attempt.

nodes.label: Write identity contract
nodes.norm_label: write identity contract
nodes.rationale: Every formal write must bind task id, canonical task path, current Git worktree root, and authenticated task workspace before producing target bytes.

nodes.label: Official acceptance derivation
nodes.norm_label: official acceptance derivation
nodes.rationale: Acceptance coverage must remain on the existing official derivation writer so caller payloads cannot override it and no second acceptance projection is created.

nodes.label: Authorized remote cleanup
nodes.norm_label: authorized remote cleanup
nodes.rationale: Remote task-branch deletion is permitted only after canonical authorization and remains nested in the existing cleanup action rather than creating a new close control plane.

nodes.label: Quality evidence discipline
nodes.norm_label: quality evidence discipline
nodes.rationale: RED must fail at the named behavior, GREEN must use the same oracle, and unknown, unavailable, partial, and incomplete facts must stay explicit rather than becoming completion claims.

nodes.label: No new control plane
nodes.norm_label: no new control plane
nodes.rationale: The plan preserves existing public commands, frozen schemas, and writers; cleanup and interaction changes stay within existing actions and kernel publication paths.

nodes.label: Talk/Grill/Clarify 批量 frontier 交互协议
nodes.norm_label: talk/grill/clarify 批量 frontier 交互协议
nodes.rationale: 串行逐题交互是主要时间/token 浪费；一次只问互不依赖、Agent 无法查明的问题，单题单决策轴、2～3 个有效选项，保留部分回复并重排 frontier，可降低决策成本而不取消真实 ask/wait/reply/resume 合同。

nodes.label: mini-task 精简独立功能交付流程
nodes.norm_label: mini-task 精简独立功能交付流程
nodes.rationale: 完整五阶段对边界清楚的小功能过重，聊天直改又缺质量与交付；mini-task 紧凑复用四材料、两次专用审查和真实 Git 交付，替代历史 scope_revision，但不成为第六 stage 或第五材料；范围膨胀时暂停由用户选择。

nodes.label: spec-analyze 五阶段窄一致性 profile（公共核心 + requirement-lineage）
nodes.norm_label: spec-analyze 五阶段窄一致性 profile(公共核心 + requirement-lineage)
nodes.rationale: 复用现有 spec-analyze 单入口与 requirement-lineage：维护成本最低，避免五个相邻入口或五套规则漂移；必须先修复 build-plan 声明调用但运行时未调用/测试反向禁止的现有矛盾（R-016、R-097）。

nodes.label: 最小 step outcome 事实（step_id/status/输入/结果/证据/原因）
nodes.norm_label: 最小 step outcome 事实(step_id/status/输入/结果/证据/原因)
nodes.rationale: 历史 M15 故障显示 manifest 声明不等于真实执行、stage 绿色会掩盖 step 静默丢失；用既有 facts 承载最小 outcome，缺失乱序可被发现，但不新增 ledger 或 gate。

nodes.label: 通用 wh-review 三次 fresh 异源请求与 SAME_SOURCE fallback
nodes.norm_label: 通用 wh-review 三次 fresh 异源请求与 same_source fallback
nodes.rationale: provider 故障不得让重要 review step 被跳过或伪装完成，也不能无限冻结任务；同一 snapshot 上最多三次新的公开异源请求，仍失败只用当前 provider 独立子代理并如实标记，质量保持 incomplete，带风险交付需另行接受。

nodes.label: DEC-001 Stage Agent 执行，runtime 只认证并透传 outcome
nodes.norm_label: dec-001 stage agent 执行,runtime 只认证并透传 outcome
nodes.rationale: 补足真实证据链但不建设第二套工作流引擎：只认证现有 manifest ID 与 evidence ref/hash，拒绝调用方自报 executed，缺证据保持 missing/unknown。

nodes.label: DEC-002 runReview 单 attempt，CLI 组合三次 fresh 公开请求
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 runreview 单 attempt,cli 组合三次 fresh 公开请求
nodes.rationale: 不改 3rd-review 私有 lifecycle、不做隐藏 retry，而用现有公开请求原语满足恢复要求，使每次 attempt 都可回放；SAME_SOURCE 或漂移 packet 不得计为异源成功。

nodes.label: DEC-003 mini-task 是非 stage 薄 skill，不是第六 stage
nodes.norm_label: dec-003 mini-task 是非 stage 薄 skill,不是第六 stage
nodes.rationale: 复用 bootstrap/workspace/四材料 writer/review/task-close，仅补薄顺序编排；不伪造 verify-code completion，不新增 proof mode 或任务关系对象。

nodes.label: Stage outcome bridge：内容寻址 stage-outcomes 记录与唯一接线
nodes.norm_label: stage outcome bridge:内容寻址 stage-outcomes 记录与唯一接线
nodes.rationale: Stage Agent 用 publishCanonicalRecord 写 quality/evidence/stage-outcomes/<stage>/<sha256>.json，officialStageHandler 用现有 task record 做 hash/snapshot/manifest 认证后透传，stageMonitoringFacts 保持唯一 consumer；retry 不覆盖旧记录，无记录时仍输出 missing/unknown。

nodes.label: FR-GOV-001 只复用四材料/facts/lineage/七类 public runtime
nodes.norm_label: fr-gov-001 只复用四材料/facts/lineage/七类 public runtime
nodes.rationale: 不得新增第五材料、第六 stage、第二 provider 生命周期、质量推进 gate 或历史 runtime 分支；检查只暴露事实并限制虚假完成。

nodes.label: FR-MINI-001 mini-task 紧凑四材料与两次审查
nodes.norm_label: fr-mini-001 mini-task 紧凑四材料与两次审查

nodes.label: D-001 完成判据=十条验收逐条最小留证
nodes.norm_label: d-001 完成判据=十条验收逐条最小留证
nodes.rationale: 能力已验证（F-001/F-002），缺的是可复查证据，因此判据定为 roadmap M17a/M17b 十条验收逐条有最小留证（一个汇总文档/一个测试文件/一次存档输出），使 M17 可宣告完成且 M18 不被卡；被拒方案：严格留证过重、记录全砍卡住 M18、折中砍半缺两条验收。风险：「从简」滑向「不做」，已写入失败边界防线。

nodes.label: D-005 四批执行（簿记→纯归位→多 CLI→留证验收）
nodes.norm_label: d-005 四批执行(簿记→纯归位→多 cli→留证验收)
nodes.rationale: 接受盲审 FND-001b：归位类工作零行为变更需要独立验证，因此把纯归位独立成批独立验收，避免与簿记批混批削弱失败边界防线；代价是多一批次开销，换隔离可验。supersedes T-006 的三批划分。

nodes.label: D-009 孤儿三技能删二留一
nodes.norm_label: d-009 孤儿三技能删二留一
nodes.rationale: 死契约删除+活引用保留，使账面与现实一致：qa-only（职责有意废除）与 verify-change（输入契约无生产者）删除；resolving-merge-conflicts 因 core/task-close.mjs 冲突报错路径仍有活消费者而保留并登记消费者，避免报错指引落空；恢复成本=从 git 历史捞。

nodes.label: D-010 显式身份与 Stage Agent outcome（不读宿主 transcript）
nodes.norm_label: d-010 显式身份与 stage agent outcome(不读宿主 transcript)
nodes.rationale: main 已接受 ADR-0024 并移除隐式宿主会话绑定，继续实现旧 session/env/v2 会恢复已接受的架构债务；因此 M17 改为宿主显式 --project/--task 或认证 worktree 定位任务、显式提交 session/unavailable 结果，由现有 bridge 生成 workflowhub-stage-outcomes.v1、公共 run 消费 outcome_ref。取舍：宿主多承担结构化结果责任，换核心不读 transcript、无第二控制面。被拒：恢复旧模块、WorkflowHub 扫描 Claude transcript、新增 Claude dispatch。supersedes D-004/D-006 相关部分。

nodes.label: DEF-001 延期 F1（多 CLI seam 泛化 + cli_map + Kimi）
nodes.norm_label: def-001 延期 f1(多 cli seam 泛化 + cli_map + kimi)
nodes.rationale: 第四宿主出现前泛化=无消费者抽象，故随 Kimi 一并延期为独立任务；延期 md 原仅存本机下载目录（FND-005），簿记批负责归档进仓并登记 move-map。

nodes.label: F-001 29 个依赖技能全部 repo-local
nodes.norm_label: f-001 29 个依赖技能全部 repo-local
nodes.rationale: 五段 29 个去重依赖技能全 repo-local（SKILL.md+sha256 bundle 零缺失），local-skill-resolver.mjs 硬锁 <root>/skills/，workflows/runtime/tools 对 superpowers/gstack 零运行时引用——这是用户「干净环境可跑通」主张的结构性证据。

nodes.label: F-002 多 CLI 兼容现状（仅 Codex+DSH 接入 runtime）
nodes.norm_label: f-002 多 cli 兼容现状(仅 codex+dsh 接入 runtime)
nodes.rationale: 仓内接进 runtime 的宿主仅 Codex+DSH，stage-runtime.mjs 是唯一归一化点且只覆盖 requirement_message；设计刻意「宿主中立核心+仓外归一」，故 M17b 缺口是记录而非能力。

nodes.label: Constitution Check（F1-F11/Q1-Q3/S1-S8 逐条）
nodes.norm_label: constitution check(f1-f11/q1-q3/s1-s8 逐条)
nodes.rationale: 计划绑定 CONSTITUTION.md v1.7.0（hash e400d447…、22 clause）：薄核心、窄契约、无新控制面、质量靠异源审查、简单优先、可证伪不假绿；F5 明确本任务不把全量 npm test 作为 gate，只以 focused tests 核验并保留历史失败事实。

nodes.label: DEC-02 显式身份与 outcome 边界（复用 main 实现）
nodes.norm_label: dec-02 显式身份与 outcome 边界(复用 main 实现)
nodes.rationale: 复用 main 已有的 --project/--task、认证 worktree、Stage Agent bridge 与 public run；否决恢复旧宿主绑定（违反 ADR-0024）与新增 Claude transcript 扫描或第二套 dispatch（重复控制面）。

nodes.label: Phase B1 簿记批
nodes.norm_label: phase b1 簿记批
nodes.rationale: 孤儿技能裁定、复用登记同步、move-map 修复+延期文档归档+知识库回写使账面与现实一致；STOP=待删技能出现新消费者，全部改动可 git revert。

nodes.label: Phase B2 纯归位批
nodes.norm_label: phase b2 纯归位批
nodes.rationale: 死代码删除、review 双副本收敛、核验 main 已完成的 stage-content-contracts 归位、task-capability 迁移，零行为变更；STOP=任一归位需要改逻辑才能过测试（改逻辑属 F3 延期范围）。RISK-P-01 源正则锚点与 RISK-P-04 move-map 不一致。

nodes.label: Phase B3 多 CLI 批
nodes.norm_label: phase b3 多 cli 批
nodes.rationale: 死约定删除、显式身份与 Stage Agent outcome 契约验证、Claude/宿主结果接线验证、文档对齐；先对当前 main 做契约回归，只在暴露窄缺口时修生产代码。STOP=需要读 transcript、从 session 猜身份或新增第二套控制面。

nodes.label: Phase B4 留证验收批
nodes.norm_label: phase b4 留证验收批
nodes.rationale: 清单生成器+指标扫描+X 处置+CLI 映射文档与核实记录+归一契约测试与 Claude e2e+干净安装留档，十条验收逐条最小留证；STOP=任一验收条无法留证则如实记缺口，禁止伪造通过。

nodes.label: Phase B5 M17 当前质量事实补录
nodes.norm_label: phase b5 m17 当前质量事实补录
nodes.rationale: 不扩大生产实现，只补 build-code 已暴露的五类质量事实（acceptance criteria、stage-end spec-analyze、finding dispositions、integration review、stage outcome）；外部事实不可用就留绑定完整的 unavailable，不用结构化回放冒充真实执行。

nodes.label: RISK-P-02 Claude 宿主未提交结构化 outcome 或绑定不匹配
nodes.norm_label: risk-p-02 claude 宿主未提交结构化 outcome 或绑定不匹配
nodes.rationale: 若错误兜底会伪造阶段完成，因此缺结果保持 unavailable、绑定失败原样保留并停止该次事实写入，禁止从 transcript 或评论反推；验证靠显式身份完整/部分/冲突/无认证上下文与 bridge 缺字段负例断言。

nodes.label: D-017 provider 执行无本地时限（2026-08-28 修订）
nodes.norm_label: d-017 provider 执行无本地时限(2026-08-28 修订)
nodes.rationale: 为防止卡住再加一层本地总时长会误杀正常长审查，也无法修复 OpenCode Go/Zen 约 120 秒的远端边界；删除本地期限让结束责任回到真实终态，不新增阶段、配置面、状态机或用户步骤。历史 15 分钟 deadline 与共享期限选择被本条覆盖。

nodes.norm_label: task-bootstrap 会话自动绑定

nodes.label: tools/cli/validate-stage-reflection.mjs 确定性校验器
nodes.norm_label: tools/cli/validate-stage-reflection.mjs 确定性校验器

nodes.label: AC-001 deferred_to_next_real_task
nodes.norm_label: ac-001 deferred_to_next_real_task

nodes.norm_label: human-confirmation.v3(reply_text + step_slug)

nodes.label: 判断层（judgment）vs 事实层（fact）
nodes.norm_label: 判断层(judgment)vs 事实层(fact)
nodes.rationale: 判断层是 LLM 归因记录、record_kind=judgment、非机器事实、不作质量裁决；事实层为机器采集的物理事实。区分写死以免 judgment 被当作质量结论。

nodes.label: lessons JSONL 读写约定（raw_observation / merged_lesson）
nodes.norm_label: lessons jsonl 读写约定(raw_observation / merged_lesson)

nodes.norm_label: docs/architecture/move-map.json 登记

nodes.norm_label: on_stage_end / blocking 声明式调度语义

nodes.norm_label: 页面真实浏览器 qa 证据(截图 + 操作日志)

nodes.norm_label: provenance 与历史事实只读保留

nodes.norm_label: risk-001 自评偏差

nodes.norm_label: skills/stage-reflection/(skill.md + skill-bundle.json)

nodes.norm_label: runtime/schemas/stage-reflection.v1.json
nodes.rationale: record_kind 固定 judgment、classification 七取值，禁止任何质量打分字段（score/grade/quality），以免判断层退化为质量结论。

nodes.label: Phase P1 — Bundle/catalog skill closure
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 — bundle/catalog skill closure
nodes.rationale: Sequenced first because stage-runtime facts can only depend on a reusable, locatable skill closure; the STOP condition forbids a new catalog, a second bundle generator, a permanent hash updater or a fifth stage, and a RED caused by setup failure must not proceed to GREEN.

nodes.label: Phase P2 — Single writer and narrow bridge
nodes.norm_label: phase p2 — single writer and narrow bridge
nodes.rationale: Runs second because review/completion cannot meaningfully judge provenance until the formal writer and bridge identity are closed; must stop immediately if any non-stage-runtime path can still write current quality or if a new state machine, second store or permanent compatibility chain would be required.

nodes.label: Phase P3 — Review provenance and legacy completion
nodes.norm_label: phase p3 — review provenance and legacy completion
nodes.rationale: Closes review provenance, requiredness, freshness and legacy readers; the same current-provenance fixture covers both the handler and freshness paths so the two cannot diverge, and legacy bytes must stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Phase P4 — Plan aggregate and handoff (non-behavior)
nodes.norm_label: phase p4 — plan aggregate and handoff (non-behavior)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly not a new behavior phase: it only aggregates the current snapshot and hands risks/unknowns to build-code, with all source tests READ ONLY and the sole NEW artifact being runtime-generated evidence, so a plan-level structural check cannot be mistaken for implementation completion.

nodes.label: Current completion truth table and aggregate priority
nodes.norm_label: current completion truth table and aggregate priority
nodes.rationale: D-007: completion predicates need current facts, so legacy or missing facts cannot satisfy them; the fixed aggregation order is snapshot/material/provenance -> required step/skill -> review and finding disposition -> stage-specific predicate -> handoff, and no later status may override an earlier failure. Required skills/steps must be completed, not_applicable requires trigger=false and executed=false, and unavailable/unknown/incomplete are preserved as-is.

nodes.label: Stable idempotency key, replay conflict and partial-write contract
nodes.norm_label: stable idempotency key, replay conflict and partial-write contract
nodes.rationale: Retries, duplicates and replays must not create a second canonical fact: the key is SHA-256 over the canonical narrow-outcome fields, same key plus same bytes replays to the same reference with zero delta, a byte conflict fails as BRIDGE_REPLAY_CONFLICT, and an interrupted partial write may only be recovered atomically under the same key or stay incomplete/unknown.

nodes.label: Legacy evidence read-only boundary
nodes.norm_label: legacy evidence read-only boundary
nodes.rationale: G-001: 'old evidence may be displayed' and 'old evidence may complete' are different claims; display is read-only while current completion consumes only current hash/snapshot/quality facts. Old records are never auto-rebound, written back or substituted for current review/AC/human confirmation.

nodes.label: Narrow bridge outcome contract
nodes.norm_label: narrow bridge outcome contract
nodes.rationale: The bridge must not copy stage-completion logic or own the quality namespace: it may only carry schema_version/task_id/stage/attempt_id/outcome_ref/outcome_sha256/outcome_status/producer, and every illegal lifecycle case (out-of-order, duplicate, time overlap or clock rollback, missing package, identity mismatch) returns a deterministic failed/unavailable with zero current-quality delta.

nodes.label: Broker-provenance wh-review layering (dsh = diagnostic only)
nodes.norm_label: broker-provenance wh-review layering (dsh = diagnostic only)
nodes.rationale: D-004: a local/self review has no foreign provenance, so it cannot satisfy a formal quality conclusion; only a canonical broker-provenance wh-review bound to the current snapshot/material/review-track may enter verify-code.code_review, and dsh-code-review results stay diagnostic inputs. Provider unavailability stays unavailable rather than becoming empty findings.

nodes.label: Single canonical quality writer (stage-runtime/TaskKernel)
nodes.norm_label: single canonical quality writer (stage-runtime/taskkernel)
nodes.rationale: D-006: multiple writers let the same fact be overwritten or forked, destroying immutable lineage; therefore all non-stage-runtime writes to the current quality namespace must be explicitly rejected with a zero current-quality delta, while legacy reads and isolated fixtures move to non-current paths instead of a permanent double-write compatibility bridge.

nodes.label: Skill closure consistency (bundle/catalog/release/resolver)
nodes.norm_label: skill closure consistency (bundle/catalog/release/resolver)
nodes.rationale: D-005: the current problem is hash/closure drift, not a missing second release system, so the existing bundle generator/catalog/local resolver/closure checker are reused as the single closure owner and only contract tests plus negative cases are added; a second bundle truth, manual hash updater or replacement catalog is explicitly rejected.

nodes.rationale: Pass/fail gates must preserve the tested command exit status; display pipelines such as grep, head, or awk must not create fake green results.

nodes.label: Stale Cross-Artifact Analysis
nodes.norm_label: stale cross-artifact analysis
nodes.rationale: A closure report claiming zero blocking findings is invalid while data-contracts, scope boundaries, or gate commands still retain the reported defects.

nodes.label: Runtime Close Artifact Timing

nodes.rationale: build-plan verification should check the intended verify-code path rule; existence of stage-result.json belongs after verify-code close executes.

nodes.norm_label: f11 normal execution and limited control plane

nodes.norm_label: f3 current materials and truthful completion
nodes.rationale: Separates current materials from read-only history and from actual write and completion facts.

nodes.label: F7 Human gates and authorization
nodes.norm_label: f7 human gates and authorization
nodes.rationale: Human choices cover direction and plan; continuous task authorization permits necessary delivery, with one final close confirmation.

nodes.label: F8 Simple first
nodes.norm_label: f8 simple first
nodes.rationale: Prefers fewer dependencies and existing consumers over replacement, rebinding, recovery, or second progress platforms.

nodes.label: Q2 Separate basis, writing, and completion
nodes.norm_label: q2 separate basis, writing, and completion
nodes.rationale: Materials answer what to do, protected I/O and authorization answer how to write, and real results and evidence answer what was completed.

nodes.label: S1 Reuse external skills
nodes.norm_label: s1 reuse external skills
nodes.rationale: Mature external skills are preferred over rebuilding generic capabilities, while the adopted files remain locally manageable.

nodes.label: S2 Adapt external skills constitutionally
nodes.norm_label: s2 adapt external skills constitutionally
nodes.rationale: External skills may be changed locally when needed to fit this project's principles instead of being accepted unchanged.

nodes.label: S7 One stage, one skill
nodes.norm_label: s7 one stage, one skill
nodes.rationale: One independent skill per stage and one folder per workflow keeps additions isolated and leaves the core unchanged.

nodes.label: S8 Portable skills
nodes.norm_label: s8 portable skills
nodes.rationale: Skills should be independently callable and portable across hosts and projects rather than bound to one environment.

nodes.label: runtime/stage/protocol-error-whitelist.mjs
nodes.norm_label: runtime/stage/protocol-error-whitelist.mjs
nodes.rationale: 新增唯一窄模块：深冻结白名单常量（15 类历史条目+1 个显式发布瞬态类）+ classify(error)→protocol_error|quality_failure + 诊断负载构造，默认分支 quality_failure；move-map 登记唯一 consumer=stage-runner 失败通道与预检命令。

nodes.label: runtime/stage/stage-runner.mjs
nodes.norm_label: runtime/stage/stage-runner.mjs
nodes.rationale: 两个改动面：失败通道分层（publication-only retry + 痕迹写入）与 verify-code 分支绑定派生（2255-2280 三个 throw 分支为 FR-BIND-001/002 唯一实现宿主）。

nodes.label: D-010 分层规则硬编码 + 默认保守
nodes.norm_label: d-010 分层规则硬编码 + 默认保守
nodes.rationale: 分层是分错就会出漏洞的边界：协议错误白名单硬编码于 runtime 常量并以契约测试钉死，未列名错误默认按质量失败拦；被拒方案=配置文件可调（多配置面且可被放宽绕过 fail-closed）。

nodes.label: D-012 绑定范围收窄为当前已认证 outcome 派生
nodes.norm_label: d-012 绑定范围收窄为当前已认证 outcome 派生
nodes.rationale: 不扩展 canonical review attempt/result schema、不新增 invocation 绑定字段或账本；只证明当前认证 outcome 已绑定该 review，从而消除 host 猜 ref 与 advisory review 冒充 canonical review，同时避免中等规模的 review 存储/schema/写入器联动改造。Supersedes D-005 中“同 invocation 唯一审查记录”部分。

nodes.label: D-013 原地重发限定为同次调用内一次 publication 重试
nodes.norm_label: d-013 原地重发限定为同次调用内一次 publication 重试
nodes.rationale: handler/LLM 只调用一次；仅当已得到合法 handler result 且失败发生在 publication 阶段时最多重试一次纯 publication。信封只存在内存，不序列化、不作为下次调用 permit、不形成 continuation/recovery/checkpoint；需固定 captured timestamp 与 create-only/同字节幂等语义。

nodes.label: D-016 协议痕迹复用既有 facts.jsonl 十字段
nodes.norm_label: d-016 协议痕迹复用既有 facts.jsonl 十字段
nodes.rationale: 每次协议错误成功原地修复后追加一条既有 task-fact.v1 事实（source=protocol_error:<class_id>、status=repaired_in_place、output_ref=facts.jsonl），不新增账本/质量 fact/存储面；只在成功发布后追加，失败尝试不伪造 repaired。若既有 facts API 无法承载则停止退回规划。

nodes.label: lessons 失败证据统计（F-001）
nodes.norm_label: lessons 失败证据统计(f-001)
nodes.rationale: 两项目 lessons 逐条统计：绑定类错误 ≥7 次（requires bound/is not bound/not current）、SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED ≥5 次、单任务 build-code 重跑 31 次、PaperBuilder f17 因 close 授权 not current 从未关闭——这是本任务成立的实测依据（非 YAGNI）。

nodes.label: 协议错误（protocol_error）
nodes.norm_label: 协议错误(protocol_error)
nodes.rationale: 机械协议错误（schema 校验失败、receipt 字段错误、绑定/ref 不一致、acceptance_coverage 形状错误）可原地修正重发，不重跑 LLM，不算质量问题；权威来源是 runtime 常量白名单（D-010）。

nodes.label: 质量失败（quality_failure）
nodes.norm_label: 质量失败(quality_failure)
nodes.rationale: 质量裁决失败（review finding、代码审查结论）保持 fail-closed，语义不变；未列入白名单的错误默认按此类处理（D-010 默认保守兜底 RISK-001）。

nodes.label: DEC-BIND 绑定派生实现面（stage-runner verify-code 分支）
nodes.norm_label: dec-bind 绑定派生实现面(stage-runner verify-code 分支)
nodes.rationale: 选 extend stage-runner；只有当 stage outcome 已通过 authenticateStageOutcome 且 code_review 的 stage/step/skill/ref/hash 完整有效时才把该 pair 复制到本次 handler input；不从 review 目录枚举或选择“最新”记录。拒绝 task-kernel 托管（绑定发生在 stage 发布边界，属 stage-runner 职责）。

nodes.label: DEC-CLASS 白名单载体（新窄模块）
nodes.norm_label: dec-class 白名单载体(新窄模块)
nodes.rationale: 选 new 窄模块 runtime/stage/protocol-error-whitelist.mjs；拒绝内联（预检命令也要消费=两处真相）与配置文件（可被放宽，违 D-010）；F10 四问：纯分类常量不扩大攻击面、失败通道只 throw 字符串故无既有载体、深冻结无配置读取路径不可绕过、维护成本低。

nodes.label: DEC-TRACE 痕迹复用 appendTaskFact 十字段
nodes.norm_label: dec-trace 痕迹复用 appendtaskfact 十字段
nodes.rationale: 首次分类时捕获 occurred_at，仅在一次 retry publication 成功后调用 appendTaskFact 一次；append/index 失败不重试 publication、不重跑 handler/LLM、不伪称痕迹已持久化；不得新增字段/companion record/quality fact/第二账本；无法以真实可审计值填满十字段则 STOP 退回 spec/plan。

nodes.label: FR-BIND-001 绑定自动派生
nodes.norm_label: fr-bind-001 绑定自动派生
nodes.rationale: 来源必须是同 task/verify-code/当前 snapshot-material/manifest/step-skill 认证过的唯一 canonical dsh-code-review pair；缺 outcome/认证失败/pair 不完整/无法唯一确定时拒绝派生并保留 unavailable/incomplete，不伪造绑定；review attempt/result 不新增 invocation 字段（跨 invocation provenance 延期）。

nodes.label: FR-CLASS-001 协议错误原地修正重发
nodes.norm_label: fr-class-001 协议错误原地修正重发
nodes.rationale: 只覆盖发布/记录边界的协议错误，不含质量裁决与 handler 内部业务失败；LLM 审查内容与已认证事实不因重发而重跑或失效。

nodes.label: FR-CLASS-002 默认保守分类
nodes.norm_label: fr-class-002 默认保守分类
nodes.rationale: 判定规则为 runtime 常量 + 契约测试，不引入配置文件/开关/环境变量；白名单每次变更都是代码评审对象（RISK-001 的兜底）。

nodes.label: FR-CLASS-003 协议错误白名单枚举（15 类）
nodes.norm_label: fr-class-003 协议错误白名单枚举(15 类)
nodes.rationale: 唯一权威清单：verify-code 绑定 4 类 + close 授权 6 环节 + build-code/build-plan schema 5 类；含仅供发布瞬态注入/适配的显式 stage_publication_transient 类，任意未知发布错误或 EEXIST 不视为可重试。

nodes.label: FR-CLASS-004 协议错误痕迹事实
nodes.norm_label: fr-class-004 协议错误痕迹事实
nodes.rationale: 痕迹不影响阶段质量结论、不作为 incomplete 依据、不可静默省略；只复用既有 task-fact.v1/appendTaskFact，material_digest 用 materialRevisionFromValues 的 64-hex，content_hash 用 canonicalJson 对 stage/class_id/occurred_at/status 的 SHA-256；十字段无法承载即停止退回规划。

nodes.label: FR-COMPAT-001 旧记录只读
nodes.norm_label: fr-compat-001 旧记录只读
nodes.rationale: 改造前旧 stage outcome/失败事实/授权记录的原始字节与内容哈希不变；新事实只经 appendTaskFact 追加为 facts.jsonl 新行，做法定位用返回 ref（facts.jsonl#行号）+ sha256 + index.json 条目，绝不修改旧记录字节流；不做迁移或修复工具。

nodes.label: T102 GREEN：白名单常量与分类器
nodes.norm_label: t102 green:白名单常量与分类器
nodes.rationale: completed（2026-09-03）：实现 15 个历史协议错误类+1 个显式瞬态 publication 类，未知错误不重试；白名单深冻结、无配置/环境覆盖；gate=protocol-error-classification.test.mjs（6 passed）。

nodes.label: T104 GREEN：失败通道分层改造
nodes.norm_label: t104 green:失败通道分层改造
nodes.rationale: completed：合法 handler result 后只进入 publication-only retry，handler/LLM 不重跑，失败不伪造 repaired fact；quality failure/unavailable 不放行；append/index 失败按 D-016 原 writer 错误 fail-loud。

nodes.norm_label: t202 green:绑定派生实现

nodes.label: T502 GREEN：痕迹写入实现
nodes.norm_label: t502 green:痕迹写入实现
nodes.rationale: completed：成功重试后追加一条 repaired_in_place facts 行，十字段均由 authenticated context 填充；无新账本/字段/quality fact；失败仍 fail-loud，不重跑 handler/LLM。

nodes.label: Fake-green / non-executable verification gates
nodes.norm_label: fake-green / non-executable verification gates
nodes.rationale: Recurring blocker family: gates that grep document text instead of exercising behavior, swallow exit codes via pipes, treat grep exit 1 as pass, or only display counts (git worktree list | wc -l) without before/after comparison — all unable to distinguish real pass from false green.

nodes.label: Forbidden-file conflict: build-spec/build-plan SKILL.md read-only vs minimal-edit
nodes.norm_label: forbidden-file conflict: build-spec/build-plan skill.md read-only vs minimal-edit
nodes.rationale: plan.md marked workflows/build-spec/SKILL.md and workflows/build-plan/SKILL.md as forbidden/read-only while T005 allowed minimal edits to them, giving implementers contradictory instructions; persisted across rounds and drove escalation.

nodes.label: FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004: per-stage/per-phase commit coverage matrix
nodes.norm_label: fr-worktree-commit-004: per-stage/per-phase commit coverage matrix
nodes.rationale: Spec requires every pipeline stage/phase (make-decision, build-spec, build-plan, build-code per phase, verify-code, close) to produce a commit or a no-change record, so stage artifacts stay traceable; tasks repeatedly failed to land the full matrix.

nodes.label: FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-009: specs/{task-id}/ storage boundary
nodes.norm_label: fr-worktree-scope-009: specs/{task-id}/ storage boundary
nodes.rationale: Spec allows only spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md under specs/{task-id}/ while the repo directory held research.md, data-contracts.md, baseline-report.md, stage-result.json and more; process artifacts must live under task_tracking_root.

nodes.label: stage-result filename contract conflict (stage-result.json vs stage-result-verify-code.json)
nodes.norm_label: stage-result filename contract conflict (stage-result.json vs stage-result-verify-code.json)
nodes.rationale: spec.md FR-WORKTREE-CLOSE-006 required {{task_tracking_root}}/tasks/{task-id}/stage-result.json while T006 wrote stage-result-verify-code.json and plan.md mixed both; without one authoritative filename close verdict evidence becomes untraceable.

nodes.label: worktree-unification build-plan task package (spec/plan/tasks/data-contracts)
nodes.norm_label: worktree-unification build-plan task package (spec/plan/tasks/data-contracts)
nodes.rationale: The artifact under review across all rounds: a build-plan package for unifying task worktree/material storage, repeatedly revised (rounds r7-r14) until pass.

nodes.label: Escalate-to-human rule (FR-REV-001 / same-finding multi-round escalation)
nodes.norm_label: escalate-to-human rule (fr-rev-001 / same-finding multi-round escalation)
nodes.rationale: When the same blocking finding persists across consecutive review rounds (three rounds unclosed), the reviewer escalates to a human instead of issuing another revise_required; also triggered when the review provider emits non-JSON output.

nodes.label: task-id normalization (FR-WORKTREE-MAKEDECISION-002 / data-contracts Contract 3)
nodes.norm_label: task-id normalization (fr-worktree-makedecision-002 / data-contracts contract 3)
nodes.rationale: make-decision must normalize human task-id input before validation: lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens, collapse consecutive hyphens, trim edge hyphens, then validate ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+){1,2}$; e.g. 'Worktree Unification' -> 'worktree-unification', 'My_Feature123' fails loud.

nodes.label: build-code SKILL.md §15 final-atomic-commit vs per-phase commit conflict
nodes.norm_label: build-code skill.md §15 final-atomic-commit vs per-phase commit conflict
nodes.rationale: After adding the per-phase commit rule (commit after each phase GREEN, before next phase), §15 still said 'Commit only at the final semantic completion point', contradicting FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004 stage traceability.

nodes.label: Close archive commit message: workflowhub(close): archive {task-id}
nodes.norm_label: close archive commit message: workflowhub(close): archive {task-id}
nodes.rationale: spec.md fixes the verify-code close archive commit message as 'workflowhub(close): archive {task-id}'; T008 gates repeatedly checked a generic archive commit or the wrong workflowhub(verify-code) prefix instead.

nodes.label: build-code SKILL.md §17 stale auto-create worktree fallback
nodes.norm_label: build-code skill.md §17 stale auto-create worktree fallback
nodes.rationale: §17 still created the worktree and wrote worktree.json when the file was missing, while spec requires build-code to fail loud and escalate_to_human on missing worktree.json; auto-creation would mask a broken cross-stage contract.

nodes.label: data-contracts Contract 4 per-stage commit coverage denominator
nodes.norm_label: data-contracts contract 4 per-stage commit coverage denominator
nodes.rationale: Contract 4 Owner side / Per-stage commit coverage / Version Compatibility Notes shrank the commit obligation to make-decision + build-code per phase + verify-code close, omitting build-spec/build-plan/verify-code rows that spec.md FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004 requires; stayed open across r12-r13.

nodes.label: core/worktree-context.mjs shared worktree.json reader
nodes.norm_label: core/worktree-context.mjs shared worktree.json reader
nodes.rationale: Introduced in r13 as the real shared read command so T005 gates exercise actual behavior instead of grepping text; had to be registered in plan.md scope/source lists, data-contracts, and be created by an explicit task (T001) before T005 verifies it — closure confirmed in r14.

nodes.label: core/task-dir-parser.mjs (ESM parseTaskDir)
nodes.norm_label: core/task-dir-parser.mjs (esm parsetaskdir)
nodes.rationale: Parser resolving task_tracking_root from WORKFLOWHUB_TASK_DIR env or config/workflowhub.yaml (with /tasks suffix trimming), fail-loud when both missing; review found gates calling it via require().then() despite ESM sync export, and lacking persistent unit tests.

nodes.label: worktree.json locating contract (data-contracts Contract 1)
nodes.norm_label: worktree.json locating contract (data-contracts contract 1)
nodes.rationale: Consumers must first resolve task_tracking_root via core/task-dir-parser.mjs, then read {{task_tracking_root}}/tasks/{task-id}/worktree.json, then use its target_repo_root/worktree_root fields; saying consumers locate files through worktree_root is circular for worktree.json itself.

nodes.label: D-001 三个痛点各有独立根因
nodes.norm_label: d-001 三个痛点各有独立根因
nodes.rationale: 痛点1根因=make-decision 无规划任务概念；痛点2=spec-prd 模板无章节白名单且无篇幅纪律；痛点3=build-prd 无复盘步且归档写死在 close 五步内。三者互不依赖，可独立修复与独立验收，因此不合并成一个大改。

nodes.label: D-002 核心杠杆是任务类型
nodes.norm_label: d-002 核心杠杆是任务类型
nodes.rationale: 全局收紧提问规则会破坏普通任务上游信息完整性（普通任务问清数据状态/页面范围/失败边界是正确的），故改动落在任务类型维度而非全局。

nodes.label: D-004 规划任务提问边界（10 类实现细节禁项）
nodes.norm_label: d-004 规划任务提问边界(10 类实现细节禁项)
nodes.rationale: 只问用户可见行为、工作流程、完成/失败条件、不变量、约束、非目标与延期；禁项为路径、函数名、字段名、算法、schema 形状、命令形态、入口参数、行号、代码片段、测试与实测记录共 10 类。此清单是该维度唯一权威口径，其他条目只引用不另立措辞；禁项留给子任务自己的 make-decision/build-spec/build-plan。

nodes.label: D-006 规划任务 PRD 内容边界
nodes.norm_label: d-006 规划任务 prd 内容边界
nodes.rationale: 保留导航、产品总览（含完整旅程与需求覆盖）、共享定义、任务地图、任务卡、风险与交付说明、变更说明；移除模板外的实测记录/命令原文类章节。“完整旅程与需求覆盖”来自既有母决策 D35，不是本任务新增范围，且只作用于规划任务。

nodes.label: D-007 PRD 必须有可执行任务清单
nodes.norm_label: d-007 prd 必须有可执行任务清单
nodes.rationale: 旧材料里 grep Goal 为 0 命中、30 条 acceptance 绑在 OI 问题而非任务上，因此每条任务至少含目标、边界、验收、依赖。

nodes.label: D-010 build-prd 阶段末非 stage 复盘
nodes.norm_label: d-010 build-prd 阶段末非 stage 复盘
nodes.rationale: 复用 runtime/review/stage-materials.json 已声明但无生产者无消费者的 non_stage.build_prd.optional.reflection_facts，补齐两端；不接 stage-reflection/stage_outcome 强闭环（6 处 stage 身份硬耦合且 portable 白名单禁止 stage_outcome），不新增 stage 或 store。

nodes.label: D-011 收口四动作、不写 close 完成记录
nodes.norm_label: d-011 收口四动作、不写 close 完成记录
nodes.rationale: 锚点是宪法已有“阶段收口可能触发也可能不触发交付动作集”语义；执行 commit/merge/push/cleanup 四个既有独立授权动作、跳过 archive-spec、不写 operations/close/completed.json。接受代价：没有单独的“已收口未归档”记录，只能从授权与 Git 事实读回。

nodes.label: D-012 可归档判定与人工归档
nodes.norm_label: d-012 可归档判定与人工归档
nodes.rationale: 原本为“自动判定+人工归档”，其前半（自动判定）已由 D-027 降级为人工声明；后半“归档动作仍须用户明确下令、延期项无人值守自动归档继续成立”不变。

nodes.label: D-027 归档判定降级为人工声明，不建机器清单与任务链
nodes.norm_label: d-027 归档判定降级为人工声明,不建机器清单与任务链
nodes.rationale: D-021 六步链路中只有“人下令归档”落在既有结构上：母任务清单无权威登记位、全仓无 task↔task 链字段、清单条目无 task_id 故 N/M/N−M 无来源、review result schema 封闭无该结论位。故交付用户可见部分（不在子任务未完成时提前归档）但不做机器判定：D-013/D-014/D-021 的机器可读部分降级为不实现，原始动机由 AC-17/AC-10 继续保证。

nodes.label: D-031 规划收口允许裁剪既有物理交付动作集
nodes.norm_label: d-031 规划收口允许裁剪既有物理交付动作集
nodes.rationale: 实测不存在“完成提交/合并/推送/清理四动作而不执行归档”的既有路径，而 D-011 又禁止改物理交付动作集，构成自相矛盾。用户裁定选项 B：授权为规划收口裁剪动作集，去掉归档；据此放宽 D-011 中“不改 DELIVERY_STEPS”这一条自我限制，其余不变，且本项改动不需重走独立审查。

nodes.label: D-032 保留主仓同相对路径，正常 cleanup
nodes.norm_label: d-032 保留主仓同相对路径,正常 cleanup
nodes.rationale: “材料留在原位置”指主仓 specs/<task-id>/ 仓库相对路径保持而非保留专属 worktree 绝对路径；cleanup 前须能从已合并已推送的主仓目标分支读回材料，失败时不删除唯一副本、不写收口完成记录。被拒备选为“保留原 worktree、cleanup 延后到归档”。

nodes.label: D-033 正常 cleanup 后窄扩展现有 close 支持人工归档

nodes.label: D-001 打通原始需求到安全 close 的完整标准流程
nodes.norm_label: d-001 打通原始需求到安全 close 的完整标准流程
nodes.rationale: 缺陷横跨需求、step 准入、质量事实、下游 gating 和 close；局部文档修复不能形成闭环，因此选择全链路合同并用分阶段实现控制复杂度。

nodes.label: D-002 历史失败模式回归 + 一个简单全流程任务
nodes.norm_label: d-002 历史失败模式回归 + 一个简单全流程任务
nodes.rationale: 单靠合成测试抓不到 Agent 行为，全量重跑三个真实任务成本过高；历史缺陷做 fixture 加一个简单 dogfood 兼顾真实性与维护成本。

nodes.label: D-003 强化现有 completion 派生而不新增推进 gate
nodes.norm_label: d-003 强化现有 completion 派生而不新增推进 gate
nodes.rationale: 工作资格与完成判据必须分离：不能用 review/上游 quality 卡死编辑，但 stage outcome 缺失不能完成，所以复用现有 validator、completion predicate、projection 和 close preflight。

nodes.label: D-004 方向变化在同一 task 重编当前材料
nodes.norm_label: d-004 方向变化在同一 task 重编当前材料
nodes.rationale: 阻止 build-spec/build-code 偷补需求，又避免每条消息都重跑流程；不新增 scope revision / reopen / successor 状态对象。

nodes.label: D-005 stage 专项语义审查，不重写 wh-review 合同
nodes.norm_label: d-005 stage 专项语义审查,不重写 wh-review 合同
nodes.rationale: prompt/合同已多轮优化但问题复现，根因在解析、执行、绑定、消费和完成判据；优先修生产链，仅在 fixture 证明具体漏检时窄改 prompt。

nodes.label: D-007 风险交付分层显示，每 stage 当场闭合质量
nodes.norm_label: d-007 风险交付分层显示,每 stage 当场闭合质量
nodes.rationale: stage 自己最了解当前产物，stage-end 当场发现/修复成本最低；close 只汇总和做物理边界，避免末端堆积质量债。

nodes.label: D-008 前四 stage 用 spec-analyze，verify-code 用专用 code-review closure
nodes.norm_label: d-008 前四 stage 用 spec-analyze,verify-code 用专用 code-review closure
nodes.rationale: authoring 产物需要跨材料语义检查，代码风险需要真实实现审查；两者均进入当前 stage completion，避免重复检查和新维护面。

nodes.label: D-009 registered transcript 验证投影核对 decision-log 需求全集
nodes.norm_label: d-009 registered transcript 验证投影核对 decision-log 需求全集
nodes.rationale: 真实消息是输入来源，decision-log 是编译后的当前真相，analyzer 比对二者即可，不需要 raw ledger 或第二 writer。

nodes.label: D-010 analyzer finding 在当前 stage 修复而非阻塞
nodes.norm_label: d-010 analyzer finding 在当前 stage 修复而非阻塞
nodes.rationale: analyzer 找到问题后当前 stage 直接修复，材料变化使旧检查 stale，重跑直至 current consistent；全程不需要 blocked/reopen/recovery 状态。

nodes.label: D-011 新增 vNext ADR 记录当前材料权威，旧 ADR 只读保留
nodes.norm_label: d-011 新增 vnext adr 记录当前材料权威,旧 adr 只读保留
nodes.rationale: 历史 ADR 保持不可变，新 ADR 显式 supersede 当前适用边界，最小文档改动解决权威冲突并保留历史可追溯性。

nodes.label: D-012 本任务不启动真实 Talk/Clarify 交互验收
nodes.norm_label: d-012 本任务不启动真实 talk/clarify 交互验收
nodes.rationale: 只减少本次验收的外部依赖，不删生产能力；缩短验收、避免 provider 不稳定，同时保留以后真实使用时 Talk/Clarify 必须工作的核心质量。

nodes.label: D-013 manual-close 必须执行真实物理 close
nodes.norm_label: d-013 manual-close 必须执行真实物理 close
nodes.rationale: 风险接受只放宽质量事实/product release 的 normal-close 前置，不放宽 task/snapshot/Git 目标校验，也不替代五类独立授权；复用现有 prepare/execute、operation facts 与安全重试。

nodes.label: DEC-001 扩展现有事实链而不新增控制面
nodes.norm_label: dec-001 扩展现有事实链而不新增控制面
nodes.rationale: 已有真实 consumer 和持久边界，只补断点即可满足全部 AC，维护成本最低；新建中央状态机或只改提示词都不合宪。

nodes.label: DEFER-002 真实 host 卡片焦点与键盘行为
nodes.norm_label: defer-002 真实 host 卡片焦点与键盘行为
nodes.rationale: 当前仓库不拥有 Codex host 卡片 renderer 也没有可消费 focus hook，在仓库内新增假 renderer 会违反 F10；因此在真实 renderer 证据出现前 AC-023 保持 deferred。

nodes.rationale: The public error semantics must match the lifecycle fact, so an existing semantic path (PROCESS_STALLED) is reused instead of introducing a new code family or disguising the stall as PROCESS_TIMEOUT.

nodes.norm_label: interactionbatch — one user-facing card of independent decision axes

nodes.norm_label: engineering risk handoff — plan-risk-001..004

nodes.label: File boundary — NEW / MODIFY / DO NOT TOUCH lists
nodes.norm_label: file boundary — new / modify / do not touch lists
nodes.rationale: make-decision/steps.json is verified correct and must not be rewritten (test the order instead); canonical review result, task store and the host bridge stay untouched to avoid a second authority; external dirty hunks must be preserved without reset or checkout.

nodes.label: Test strategy — paired RED/GREEN commands and oracle identities (ORACLE-P1..P4)
nodes.norm_label: test strategy — paired red/green commands and oracle identities (oracle-p1..p4)
nodes.rationale: Each behaviour task shares one executable Vitest command and oracle identity; build-plan designs the commands but only build-code executes them, recording raw stdout, exit code and phase evidence.

nodes.label: G-012 — 15-minute health-based no-progress boundary marks unavailable
nodes.norm_label: g-012 — 15-minute health-based no-progress boundary marks unavailable

nodes.label: Stage Agent host boundary — outcome becomes optional execution fact
nodes.norm_label: stage agent host boundary — outcome becomes optional execution fact
nodes.rationale: runOfficialStage() unconditionally required receipts.stage_outcomes and threw MATERIAL_INCOMPLETE without an external host, conflating execution facts with permission to proceed; per F3/Q1/Q2 the four current materials drive work, so a missing host is recorded as unavailable while the same task continues.

nodes.label: DEC-006 — External owner isolation with a narrow in-scope repair
nodes.norm_label: dec-006 — external owner isolation with a narrow in-scope repair
nodes.rationale: The real Stage Agent host and 3rd-review broker live outside this repo and their worktree is dirty; bounded edits to the declared deadline/health/direction-flow/retry bytes satisfy the authorized root-cause fix without building a second control plane or discarding user dirty facts.

nodes.label: Phase P1 — Interaction lifecycle and stage order
nodes.norm_label: phase p1 — interaction lifecycle and stage order

nodes.label: Phase P3 — Provider liveness with no fixed total deadline

nodes.label: Animate 七步动画决策链（频率闸门→目的→工具→属性→缓动/弹簧→打断退出→门控）
nodes.norm_label: animate 七步动画决策链(频率闸门→目的→工具→属性→缓动/弹簧→打断退出→门控)
nodes.rationale: 前两步（该不该动、目的命名）是闸门，可以合法地产出零行代码；所有曲线/时长/弹簧参数必须取自内置数值表，禁止凭感觉发明（H2），并须扩展既有 token 而不建平行体系（H3），由此把统一性变成铁律而非建议。

nodes.rationale: 只命名、不设计不构建；Q2 要求逐字引用权威定义、Q5 禁止发明新词，因此并入 animate 时必须全量 91 条、不做 HIGH+ 式子集裁剪，否则后续查询落到被删词条会出现假阴性。

nodes.label: 禁止布尔 prop 泛滥与 renderX props（改用显式变体组件）
nodes.norm_label: 禁止布尔 prop 泛滥与 renderx props(改用显式变体组件)
nodes.rationale: 每个布尔 prop 使可能状态数翻倍并产生不可维护的条件逻辑，读调用点也看不出实际渲染什么；显式变体（ThreadComposer/EditMessageComposer/ForwardMessageComposer）消灭不可能状态并自文档化，判据一句话：组合静态结构用 children，需要回传数据才用 render props。

nodes.label: 复合组件三段式 context 接口（state / actions / meta）与 provider 依赖注入
nodes.norm_label: 复合组件三段式 context 接口(state / actions / meta)与 provider 依赖注入
nodes.rationale: 组合优于配置：接口是契约，任何 provider 实现它、同一套 UI 即可配完全不同状态实现 —「Swap the provider, keep the UI」；关键判据是 provider 边界（而非视觉嵌套）才是有效边界，因此状态提升后 Frame 外的兄弟组件照样可读写 state/actions，同时消除 prop drilling、useEffect 向上同步与 ref 读状态三类反模式。

nodes.label: 重渲染与渲染性能规则（rerender- 15 条 / rendering- 11 条 / js- 14 条）
nodes.norm_label: 重渲染与渲染性能规则(rerender- 15 条 / rendering- 11 条 / js- 14 条)
nodes.rationale: 覆盖组件边界（禁内联组件防 remount、静态 JSX 外提、memo 边界）与渲染主线程（content-visibility 约 10×、js-index-maps 1M→2K ops）；frontmatter 的 impact 分级本身就是筛选机制，所以正确用法是保留全量 70 条 + 索引按需读取，物理裁剪会制造第二份被裁剪的真相、违反 ADR 不复制外部规则的精神。

nodes.label: 消除瀑布流与包体积优化（async- / bundle- 两类 CRITICAL 规则）
nodes.norm_label: 消除瀑布流与包体积优化(async- / bundle- 两类 critical 规则)
nodes.rationale: 瀑布流是性能第一杀手，每个串行 await 都付整次网络延迟；barrel 导入光导入即 200–800ms、Monaco 类大组件约 300KB。CRITICAL 级收益集中在数据密集前端，规则以「判据 + 正误对照 + impact 分级」形态供生成/评审/重构逐条引用。

nodes.norm_label: confirm 公共通道承载 accepted_risk 授权
nodes.rationale: 路由仅接 acceptReviewRisk 单点、严格白名单，不新增公共 behavior 名；边界=仅 accepted_risk 授权与既有确认语义，不得扩张为通用写回通道，否则确认 receipt 绑定失效；材料变更须重建确认（SCN-008）。

nodes.label: 决策链字段与不阻断告警 checker
nodes.norm_label: 决策链字段与不阻断告警 checker
nodes.rationale: 决定区按模块 h3 分组+D-ID+derived_from 跨模块引用；文本层链字段 derived_from/module/requirement_ids/artifacts；checker 只打印告警、不进 failures、不 exit 1（记录事实而非阻断），且既有机器强制边界（16 h2/覆盖/五维/R-NNN）全绿不破。

nodes.label: deep-research R0–R5 子流程契约
nodes.norm_label: deep-research r0–r5 子流程契约
nodes.rationale: R0 缺口问题（由需求框架骨架生成）/R1–R2 并行深读/R3 三角测量/R4 落盘 research-report.v1 content-addressed 到任务质量证据区/R5 独立复核；停止条件=≤3 轮每问题+连续 2 轮无新增即饱和+时间盒；跳过需论证；纯 agent 无工具检索=不合格事实记录但不阻断；工具路由表区分外部 anysearch/web_fetch/子代理深读与内部 glob/grep/read/git/ast-grep。

nodes.label: 聚合=并集+provider×角色标注+disputed/consensus
nodes.norm_label: 聚合=并集+provider×角色标注+disputed/consensus
nodes.rationale: 以并集保留全部发现并附 provider×角色标注，把争议显式落成 disputed/consensus 标注进 clusterRecord（含一提出一沉默用例），避免聚合阶段静默吞掉分歧。

nodes.label: M/S/B/P 执行器矩阵与上下文守恒 6 规则
nodes.norm_label: m/s/b/p 执行器矩阵与上下文守恒 6 规则
nodes.rationale: 上下文守恒 6 规则=全量产物落盘 ref+sha256+≤500 字摘要/子代理回传强制结构化/并行上限（研究 4+debate 4+红蓝 2）/交互 M 独占/候选外包+裁决分级/主会话旧步骤不回读；目标是把重活移出主上下文而保持可追溯。

nodes.label: 降级标注 blue_incomplete / red_incomplete / available-with-failures
nodes.norm_label: 降级标注 blue_incomplete / red_incomplete / available-with-failures
nodes.rationale: 蓝队超时为实证风险（RISK-01 实证 4/5 失败）；缓解=incomplete 标注+同编成重试 1 次+不延长超时窗；组内单成员失败时其余成员结果照用，partial 语义=结果可用但需降级标注，不得改写为质量通过。

nodes.label: 文件 mailbox 交锋协议（单消息单文件 JSON）
nodes.norm_label: 文件 mailbox 交锋协议(单消息单文件 json)
nodes.rationale: 字段 from/to/round/seq/body|body_ref/ts，按轮次组织目录、长正文走 body_ref；mailbox 文件是权威交锋记录（裁决书必须引用），DSH 原生父子消息实测可用但仅作加速；无并行能力时降级为父代理串行转发并记录降级事实；Codex 仅 collab、Multica @mention，跨宿主运行性靠降级路径兜底（PFACT-17 inferred）。

nodes.label: material_id（broker canonical 材料身份）
nodes.norm_label: material_id(broker canonical 材料身份)
nodes.rationale: 规范算法=排除 manifest.json 与 canonical-evidence.json、按 path Buffer.compare 排序后哈希（3rd-review lib/attachments.mjs L18-26 只读参照）；material_id 变化使既有 receipt/确认绑定失效，需以新材料重建确认（SCN-008），旧 material_id 记录只读保留不回溯；P2 pair 校验依赖此算法输出。

nodes.label: pair_id / role / disputed 契约字段
nodes.norm_label: pair_id / role / disputed 契约字段
nodes.rationale: 以全部 optional 字段承载 pair 身份与角色，缺省对象保持兼容（不动既有必填字段、不升 v2）；role 枚举限制为 red|blue，非法值必须被拒绝，避免 schema 过宽。

nodes.label: 红蓝双发审查（同一逻辑 review fact）
nodes.norm_label: 红蓝双发审查(同一逻辑 review fact)
nodes.rationale: 仅 make-decision 的 direction/detail 两面各执行 red+blue 两次组请求，其余阶段维持 single_round；组请求复用同一通道、无 per-provider prompt 通道（PFACT-01）；2× 成本逼近客户端超时窗（RISK-01），因此不延长超时窗。

nodes.norm_label: 组合式需求框架 2 类 preset

nodes.rationale: 禁止无范围地跑全量 vitest/npm test/test:safe，例外仅当用户或 CI 守卫明确要求且必须在执行证据中写清原因与范围；依据 docs/standard-workflow.md 的 build-code 测试与质量段，定位为执行纪律而非新 stage/gate/质量结论。

nodes.norm_label: 执行卫生三条 + 通用委派纪律(oi-011)

nodes.label: 「声明不实」的发现路径（T-021=A）
nodes.norm_label: 「声明不实」的发现路径(t-021=a)

nodes.label: 主会话职责边界（FR-13 / AC-12 / OI-003）
nodes.norm_label: 主会话职责边界(fr-13 / ac-12 / oi-003)

nodes.label: 阶段豁免表与「大量读写」可指认阈值（T-020=A）
nodes.norm_label: 阶段豁免表与「大量读写」可指认阈值(t-020=a)

nodes.label: 红队 finding 登记 F-1…F-10
nodes.norm_label: 红队 finding 登记 f-1...f-10

nodes.label: SD-11 并行规则五件套
nodes.norm_label: sd-11 并行规则五件套

nodes.label: Claude Code agent teams 官方文档（起手 3–5、任务依赖自动解锁）
nodes.norm_label: claude code agent teams 官方文档(起手 3–5、任务依赖自动解锁)
nodes.rationale: 「Start with 3-5 teammates」「15 个任务 3 个队友就够」且上限不随任务数增长；真实依赖形态是声明式依赖 + 认领时校验 + 完成自动解锁（无中心 DAG 调度器），官方自认「Task status can lag … which blocks dependent tasks」；写集声明在业界没有机器校验先例。

nodes.label: 外部一手证据：广播「我已完成的改动」恢复 82%（arXiv:2609.25396）与文本合并冲突率 27.67%（arXiv:2604.03551）
nodes.norm_label: 外部一手证据:广播「我已完成的改动」恢复 82%(arxiv:2609.25396)与文本合并冲突率 27.67%(arxiv:2604.03551)
nodes.rationale: 构造场景干扰率 97%、一条广播消息恢复 82% 的 runs，是 SD-11 之外唯一有实测数字支撑的冲突缓解手段（T-022=A 补进 acceptance）；「文本级合并冲突率 27.67%」与「接口干扰率 1/834≈0.12%」是两个不同问题、引用不得混用；本卡未直读原文，属父代理转述。

nodes.norm_label: 批前 git 标签 backup/card-06-b4
nodes.rationale: 标签是回退依据，不是用户批准或质量通过。

nodes.norm_label: g3-09(测试前后自动快照比对退役)

nodes.norm_label: 损失1:自动拒绝错绑或过期证据退役

nodes.label: 损失②：跨宿主「此答复批准此版本」认证链退役
nodes.norm_label: 损失2:跨宿主「此答复批准此版本」认证链退役

nodes.label: 损失③：跨宿主自动恢复精确执行现场退役
nodes.norm_label: 损失3:跨宿主自动恢复精确执行现场退役

nodes.label: 损失④：机器可查的完整阶段状态退役
nodes.norm_label: 损失4:机器可查的完整阶段状态退役
nodes.rationale: status 只读基本 task/facts、材料存在性与当前 Phase/Task 游标；游标只定位续跑不证明完成，未提交材料变更不使 Git 游标 stale（T022 既定取舍）。

nodes.label: 不可接受的真正安全保护清单
nodes.norm_label: 不可接受的真正安全保护清单
nodes.rationale: 原子写与锁、realpath/symlink/nlink 拒绝、不可逆 Git 分支/HEAD 核对与单 step 消费、脱敏与 128KiB 上限等不进入可接受损失；安全缺口不得混进四项损失让用户接受。

nodes.label: 四项损失真实用户确认原件
nodes.norm_label: 四项损失真实用户确认原件
nodes.rationale: 逐字回复「接受四项损失及缓解，继续P5」，一次真实回复覆盖四项；记录 SHA256 268308ea… 与当时 HEAD 823aa21c…，不是四件独立确认。

nodes.label: P5/T016 损失清单（四项已真实确认）
nodes.norm_label: p5/t016 损失清单(四项已真实确认)

nodes.label: D-021 限定范围：只为 28 个正式单元建原子追踪
nodes.norm_label: d-021 限定范围:只为 28 个正式单元建原子追踪

nodes.label: 2026-09-22 现行处置纠偏：11 条结构层判断失效
nodes.norm_label: 2026-09-22 现行处置纠偏:11 条结构层判断失效
nodes.rationale: 原 11 条「已被 CARD02 实现无需重复」是结构或声明层判断，不能当作当前交付完成；纠偏后计数为本卡承接 16 + 交其他卡 63，原表与历史计数保留但不再用于当前覆盖结论——重新归属不使承接项自动完成。

nodes.label: 79 条处置枚举与 8/60/11 历史计数
nodes.norm_label: 79 条处置枚举与 8/60/11 历史计数
nodes.rationale: 处置枚举为本卡承接/明确排除/交其他卡/已被CARD02实现无需重复，每行恰有一个处置，交其他卡必须给 owner；明确排除=0 不是遗漏（60 条均有明确 owner），且后续来源新增或合同变化必须追加新行或显式 supersession，不得改写历史行维持计数。

nodes.label: CARD-02 验收分类：0 achieved / 18 incomplete / 2 deferred / 2 unavailable
nodes.norm_label: card-02 验收分类:0 achieved / 18 incomplete / 2 deferred / 2 unavailable
nodes.rationale: 原先 2 个 achieved 只是结构候选的旧分类（DOC-003/004 的结构子断言保留但缺弱模型独立实施与真实 index-reader 证据），不能当完整业务验收；改提交条件须由用户明确裁定，不能把 deferred/unavailable 当通过。

nodes.label: 最短修复顺序与外部事实依赖
nodes.norm_label: 最短修复顺序与外部事实依赖
nodes.rationale: 先闭合 AC-CLEAN-001 与 AC-FLOW-003 的当前生产路径清单以免污染后续正式入口证明，再补正常/失败原件；Luna 实施与真实 provider 比较明确属 CARD-10/CARD-05，没有这些外部事实「22 条全部 achieved」不能成立。

nodes.label: U-009/D-033 来源权威修订：decision-log 逐字层为原始需求权威
nodes.norm_label: u-009/d-033 来源权威修订:decision-log 逐字层为原始需求权威
nodes.rationale: 正式 reader 必须从认证 worktree 的文件字节独立提取来源 ID、位置与材料身份再反查索引与 oracle；使用 decision-log 作为权威并不授权包内自报，自然语言分句的穷尽性无法仅凭解析器证明，unknown 交独立语义审查。

nodes.label: 同源验收假绿：解析器对材料内互斥零报警
nodes.norm_label: 同源验收假绿:解析器对材料内互斥零报警
nodes.rationale: 旧 adapter 可把 decision-log 同时当原文与决策，original_requirements/coverage 由调用方自报因而漏原话仍包内自洽；空壳也能 17/17 通过，证明的是内部自洽而不是母 PRD 的物理产物目标。

nodes.label: 未闭合 9 条与承接/不承接边界
nodes.norm_label: 未闭合 9 条与承接/不承接边界
nodes.rationale: 9 条未闭合项各有 owner 与触发时点（多为 build-plan 前）；本卡承接旧机器物理删除与 runtime 覆盖校验器接线，明确不承接 CARD-03/04/05/06/08/09/10 的各自范围，并给相邻卡规定输入注入义务。

nodes.label: 结构性发现：解析器零报警与「收敛假绿」同型复现
nodes.norm_label: 结构性发现:解析器零报警与「收敛假绿」同型复现
nodes.rationale: 材料在增量修补中反复出现「同一材料内两处互斥、机器零报警」，analyzeDecisionOutline 与 analyzeDecisionConvergence 在矛盾存在时都是 passed/ok=true；因此只跑解析器不足以发现这类问题，下游起草材料后必须跑一次同类独立一致性检查。

nodes.label: 4 轮审查真实事实：108 findings / 20 blocking，无 pass 语义
nodes.norm_label: 4 轮审查真实事实:108 findings / 20 blocking,无 pass 语义
nodes.rationale: 两种计数口径都真实存在（材料采用 108/20；adjudication.clusters 114/21）引用必须写明口径；第 2 轮 red 侧失败事实原样保留（PROVIDER_RESULT_INVALID / REVIEW_WAIT_EXCEEDED），审查是 advice 不是门禁，四轮均未产出 pass 语义。

nodes.label: ADR 生命周期：单调编号 + superseded 指向替代者 + 旧记录不删
nodes.norm_label: adr 生命周期:单调编号 + superseded 指向替代者 + 旧记录不删
nodes.rationale: 编号单调不复用、被推翻的旧记录保留并标记，已接受的 ADR 不可修改只能被取代——保留的是「它曾长期治理工作」这一事实。

nodes.label: 议程/结构先行：收益与反证
nodes.norm_label: 议程/结构先行:收益与反证
nodes.rationale: 议程使用显著预测会议质量（n=367 横断自评），但先给结构等于先给示例框架，在发散阶段有机制性代价；收益侧证据强度低于反证侧。

nodes.label: 「决策疲劳」原始主张及其被大幅削弱
nodes.norm_label: 「决策疲劳」原始主张及其被大幅削弱
nodes.rationale: 作者措辞只到 suggest 且未测量疲劳；模拟再分析显示陡降大部分是统计假象（但只解释 15%–45%）；2025 注册报告在大规模医护数据上零结果（BF0+ > 22）；自我损耗重复 d = 0.04 且 CI 跨零——不应作为硬前提引用。

nodes.label: 决策台账的成熟规范形态：ADR
nodes.norm_label: 决策台账的成熟规范形态:adr

nodes.label: 设计固着（design fixation）
nodes.norm_label: 设计固着(design fixation)
nodes.rationale: 发散任务前展示示例会统计上可测地压缩解空间并提高对既有属性的复制率；这是「议程先行」在发散阶段的机制性代价（Jansson & Smith 1991，被引 994）。

nodes.label: 人机交互特有失效模式：自动化偏见、算法厌恶/欣赏、谄媚、多轮退化
nodes.norm_label: 人机交互特有失效模式:自动化偏见、算法厌恶/欣赏、谄媚、多轮退化
nodes.rationale: 自动化偏见同时产生遗漏与执行错误、训练与指令无法消除；算法欣赏在「与自己的估计比较」和「有专业经验」时消退；谄媚集中在主观题而产品决策正是主观题；多轮对话使 LLM 平均性能下降约 39% 且走错一步不恢复。

nodes.label: 需求追溯矩阵与「生产者 ≠ 消费者」结构性病灶
nodes.norm_label: 需求追溯矩阵与「生产者 = 消费者」结构性病灶
nodes.rationale: Gotel & Finkelstein 1994 把主要障碍定位为「建立追溯的人」与「使用追溯的人」需求冲突——这是「RTM 退化为没人读的官僚产物」最有力的学术解释，不是 UI 问题。

nodes.label: Satisficing（够用就好的作答降级）
nodes.norm_label: satisficing(够用就好的作答降级)
nodes.rationale: 机制性解释：一次问太多不是态度问题，而是认知负荷超过阈值后的策略性降级（Krosnick 1991）。

nodes.label: R3 不可引用清单：7±2、渐进披露归属、Twitter 59%、决策疲劳等
nodes.norm_label: r3 不可引用清单:7±2、渐进披露归属、twitter 59%、决策疲劳等
nodes.rationale: 把项目结论建立在无法溯源的数字上会污染下游；明确列出归属错误、原始文献明确否认、以及仅核实题录的条目，避免下游继续引用。

nodes.label: 对抗式审查：魔鬼代言/辩证质询（质量↑、接受度↓）
nodes.norm_label: 对抗式审查:魔鬼代言/辩证质询(质量↑、接受度↓)
nodes.rationale: DI/DA 组产生显著更高质量的假设与建议，但成员接受度/满意度更低——收益与「被接受」是两个独立变量且历史上呈负相关；且为模拟决策任务的实验室研究。

nodes.label: 审查者会被锚定，且「叫它别被锚定」无效
nodes.norm_label: 审查者会被锚定,且「叫它别被锚定」无效
nodes.rationale: 单次示例暴露把「与示例高度相似」从 7% 拉到 50%，防溢杯灵活性 0.95→0.85、原创性 0.64→0.53；明确指示「尽量生成不同的想法」也未能降低从众。

nodes.label: 缺陷修复成本曲线不可引用（1:10:100 溯源否证）
nodes.norm_label: 缺陷修复成本曲线不可引用(1:10:100 溯源否证)
nodes.rationale: 常被引的 1:6.5:15:60–100 追溯终点是 1981 年 IBM 内部培训课程笔记，且 IBM Systems Sciences Institute 是企业培训机构而非研究机构；171 个真实项目、2006–2014 的最大规模实证未发现延迟修复效应。

nodes.label: R4 失效条件清单与不可引用清单（26 条）
nodes.norm_label: r4 失效条件清单与不可引用清单(26 条)
nodes.rationale: 逐条列出「何时不该跑审查 / 审查会失效」，并纠正种子文献本身的错误（Ancker 2017 DOI、Tyser et al. arXiv 号、Kesselheim 期刊归属、Wessel 2022 标题），防止下游把无法溯源的数字写成「文献表明」。

nodes.label: 异质性收益的正面证据：PoLL、SWRBench、Doshi & Hauser
nodes.norm_label: 异质性收益的正面证据:poll、swrbench、doshi & hauser
nodes.rationale: PoLL 的收益机制被明确写成 disjoint model families（模型族不相交）而非「模型更多」，卖点是成本与偏差而非召回率；把它读成「异源提高缺陷发现率」是过度解读。

nodes.label: 多主体讨论的增益被高估：单主体 + 强提示即可复现
nodes.norm_label: 多主体讨论的增益被高估:单主体 + 强提示即可复现
nodes.rationale: 多主体只在提示中不含示例/示范时更好，而这正是「审查输入已含已选方向」的失效条件；多样性坍缩来自交互结构本身（多轮互看会加速过早收敛），不是模型不够强。

nodes.label: 审查者强弱关系只是方向性倾向而非单调定律
nodes.norm_label: 审查者强弱关系只是方向性倾向而非单调定律
nodes.rationale: CriticBench 显示强模型更擅长批评弱模型，但弱模型在自我批评上可以反超强模型；且「−8.6 个百分点」在 8 种措辞 × 2 个检索引擎加全语料 grep 下零命中，应视为项目内部数字。

nodes.norm_label: chatbot 逐题对话 vs web 批量问卷(kim et al. 2019)

nodes.norm_label: 同屏题数 1/4/10/40 对照实验(toepoel et al. 2009)
nodes.rationale: 批量提问有真实速度收益，代价是项目无回答上升与版面评价变差——明确的 trade-off，不是单向劣势。

nodes.norm_label: 矩阵题行数 5/10/20 对照实验(grady et al. 2018)
nodes.rationale: 两轮研究（N=2,492 / N=2,570）显示流失率与自评难度随行数单调上升，综合最优约 5×5；报告明确警告该单位是 survey item，换算成「一轮几个议题」只是类比。

nodes.label: 问卷长度与应答率元分析（Rolstad et al. 2011）
nodes.norm_label: 问卷长度与应答率元分析(rolstad et al. 2011)
nodes.rationale: 32 篇报告 / 20 篇纳入；总体关联 P ≤ 0.0001，但同质性 P = 0.03，作者本人限定「内容与长度无法分离」，结论是按内容而非长度决策——因此「越短越好」不是已确立结论。

nodes.norm_label: 价值导向思维压低发散数量、提高想法质量(selart & johansen 2011)

nodes.norm_label: ai 审查意见采纳率 0.9%–19.2%,人类为 60%
nodes.rationale: TSE 2026 观察 16 个 AI 审查 Action、178 个成熟仓库、22,326 条 AI 评论；未被采纳的 50 条回复中 64% 是「为现有实现辩护」——advisory-only 在现实中比人类审查低一个数量级。

nodes.label: 相关错误跨越厂商与架构边界（Kim et al., ICML 2025）
nodes.norm_label: 相关错误跨越厂商与架构边界(kim et al., icml 2025)
nodes.rationale: 350+ LLM：更大更准的模型即使架构与厂商不同，错误仍高度相关，两者都错时 60% 一致（随机基线 1/3）；裁判还会系统性高估弱于自己的模型并额外高估同厂商模型——「不同厂商 ⇒ 独立错误」这条推理链实证上不成立。

nodes.label: 九个裁判只等于约两张独立票（arXiv:2605.29800）
nodes.norm_label: 九个裁判只等于约两张独立票(arxiv:2605.29800)
nodes.rationale: 9 个前沿 LLM、7 个模型族，约四分之三名义独立性丢失，面板准确率比独立投票理想值低 8–22 个百分点，且最好的单个裁判打平或超过整个面板；与 PoLL 测量目标不同，报告不裁定而对冲突并存。

nodes.label: Phase 1 RED Contract

nodes.label: Phase 2 Skill and Document Repair

nodes.label: Phase 3 Validation and Deployment
nodes.norm_label: phase 3 validation and deployment

nodes.label: Phase 4 Canary and Close
nodes.norm_label: phase 4 canary and close
nodes.rationale: A fresh Canary verifies the full interaction and close flow, exports replayable evidence, cleans temporary resources, and stops before merge/archive authorization.

nodes.label: Amendment Scope
nodes.norm_label: amendment scope
nodes.rationale: WorkflowHub keeps only host-neutral projection and evidence contracts; Multica instructions map those contracts to host events without changing platform configuration.

nodes.label: Dynamic Round Correction
nodes.norm_label: dynamic round correction
nodes.rationale: All three talk rounds must retain their own duties, candidate queues, and post-answer reordering, but questioning stops when verified facts justify closure.

nodes.label: Host Configuration and Public Projection
nodes.norm_label: host configuration and public projection
nodes.rationale: Workspace and checkout facts are technical host configuration: check real access first, and expose user-facing Phase descriptions only as plain-language goals, criteria, allowed changes, tests, and ownership.

nodes.label: Latest Evidence and Silent No-Op
nodes.norm_label: latest evidence and silent no-op
nodes.rationale: The final build-code card is regenerated from the latest Phase and tree evidence; a completed Stage with no new action ends silently.

nodes.label: Build-Code Decision Lineage
nodes.norm_label: build-code decision lineage
nodes.rationale: The amendment records an approved lineage correction: the host-neutral build-code Skill is authoritative and can be read by different executors without changing implemented behavior.

nodes.label: Decision Source Chain
nodes.norm_label: decision source chain
nodes.rationale: Every load-bearing decision records its content, source, constraints, choice, impact, consequences, rejected alternatives, unresolved items, and any supersedes relation.

nodes.label: Grill Document Judgment
nodes.norm_label: grill document judgment
nodes.rationale: Code and documents should answer resolvable questions directly; only remaining load-bearing uncertainty is presented to the user, with CONTEXT, ADR, conflict, and exit-check conclusions recorded.

nodes.label: Host-Neutral Boundary
nodes.norm_label: host-neutral boundary
nodes.rationale: WorkflowHub exposes host-independent interaction and document results, while host-specific mappings remain outside the abstraction and no new runtime, schema, provider, or state machine is added.

nodes.label: Plain-Language Decision Cards
nodes.norm_label: plain-language decision cards
nodes.rationale: User-facing choices explain meaning, consequences, risks, and a recommendation while keeping separate decision axes out of one compound card.

nodes.label: Single-Axis Spec Clarification
nodes.norm_label: single-axis spec clarification
nodes.rationale: Spec clarification separates locked decisions, explicit unresolved items, and new ambiguity; it preserves locked wording and asks one dependent decision axis at a time.

nodes.label: Three-Round Talk Convergence
nodes.norm_label: three-round talk convergence
nodes.rationale: Each talk round has a distinct convergence responsibility, dynamically reprioritizes questions after answers, and may stop when facts are sufficient rather than manufacturing questions.

nodes.rationale: Symmetric compression and main-session authorship both have a whitening entry point (a parent session reported 148/148 green and was overturned by its own independent reviewer); an asymmetric structure that enumerates failures verbatim removes the美化 space without becoming a gate, since blocking gates would have failed 562/707 recorded stage results.

nodes.label: Four Measured Parallel Disciplines
nodes.norm_label: four measured parallel disciplines
nodes.rationale: Audits quantified the waste: subagent inheritance of the full parent transcript was 42% of session input, idle polling 27% of tokens, cross-phase full snapshot binding 60-90 minutes per session, and repeated reads/runs up to 28x; these four evidence-backed rules are promoted over the SD-11 five-piece set, which is demoted to a parallel clause.

nodes.label: Dispatch by Work Type Across Five Stages
nodes.norm_label: dispatch by work type across five stages
nodes.rationale: Dispatch unit is work type (implementation/test/review/repair), not process step number; repair returns to the same subagent session so one implementation never gets a second executorship, and the main session only dispatches, harvests and runs interactive skills.

nodes.label: Cross-Language Writing Rules (ASD-STE100 / ISO 24495-1)
nodes.norm_label: cross-language writing rules (asd-ste100 / iso 24495-1)
nodes.rationale: The worktree decision-log measured 1,854 lines / 326,870 B before rewriting versus 549 lines / 80,492 B after; growth was per-line content, so only cross-language rules were taken and the English permitted-word list plus word/sentence hard limits were discarded. Where STE and ISO conflict, ISO decides what counts as a good document.

nodes.label: Non-Identity Check Downgrade Boundary
nodes.norm_label: non-identity check downgrade boundary
nodes.rationale: Measured 146.7 wasted provider-minutes and one 67.4-minute close-out window where the same user reply had to be confirmed 4 times; checks that carry no identity, order, hash or required-artifact binding become quality facts (partial/warn/record), while identity checks keep fail-loud strength (CONSTITUTION.md:28).

nodes.label: OCR Delegation Mode
nodes.norm_label: ocr delegation mode
nodes.rationale: Four real sessions showed failures came from orchestration mechanics (all-or-nothing initial[], minimum_heterologous measured with three different rulers, quorum discarding completed reviews, timeouts not cancelling the broker), not model capability; patching the old tools leaves the lesion, so the fix is the review-layer behaviour contract.

nodes.rationale: 本机 ~/.opencodereview/config.json 不存在、未配置任何 LLM provider，ocr review 根本无法运行；委托模式是唯一立即可用的接入路径，且与用户「用 config.json 的 provider 配置做审查」的诉求吻合——config 里的 provider 正是宿主 Agent。OCR 只做确定性工程（文件筛选 + 规则解析），实际审查推理由宿主 Agent 用自己的 LLM 完成，OCR 端不调 LLM、不需 API key；代价是 OCR 不产出 finding，rubric 必须由 WorkflowHub 自带。

nodes.rationale: 例外仅三类仍附字节：该文件随后会被改动或删除、外部服务返回体、一次性环境读数。不新增去重校验器或检查工具，不设数量阈值或篇幅指标，不在本轮清理历史产物（历史清账需另开明确授权并逐件复核）。

nodes.norm_label: 证明范围只写路径 + hash,字节留在工作树
nodes.rationale: 原口径要求把本 Phase 实际改动文件的原始字节连同路径与 hash 一起保存；与「每类事实只留一份原始件」相乘后无法收敛，产物规模以数量级增长而重复存证没有消费者。改为只写路径 + hash 换取收敛，代价是可核性：工作树被改动或清理后仅凭路径与 hash 无法再核内容。

nodes.label: 同一事实＝字节相同（复用判据保守）
nodes.norm_label: 同一事实=字节相同(复用判据保守)
nodes.rationale: 重跑得到逐字节相同的结果时复用既有原件、只写引用不新写；只有在命令逐字相同、既有 ref 存在且能确立内容相等时才复用。无法确立内容相等时保留新件并记 deduplication: unknown，不得据字节数判定为重复。真实失败、取消、超时与迟到发现永不因复用被抹掉，被 ref 指向的件一律按唯一原件保留。

nodes.label: content_sha256 仅对字节级 vendored 项成立且必须复算回填
nodes.norm_label: content_sha256 仅对字节级 vendored 项成立且必须复算回填
nodes.rationale: 新增字段只有两个且条件式必填：adopted（用了哪些内容）与 content_sha256；后者仅对字节级 vendored 项成立（当前本仓只有 frontend-component-quality 一项），必须由检查器复算回填、禁止手工填写。给全部 adapted 项加内容哈希会撞上 docs/adr/0013——该 ADR 因「手工同步必然遗漏、保留即保留缺陷」已删除 catalog 的 local_bundle_hash／snapshot_sha256 并明文拒绝收敛到单一来源；新增独立检查工具则会造出无真实 consumer 的新控制面。取舍代价：18 条 adapted 项仍无内容哈希，且哈希只能证明 pin 未被替换、发现不了上游发新版（上游漂移检测默认不跑）。

nodes.label: 一致性检查追加进 reports，永不进 failures
nodes.norm_label: 一致性检查追加进 reports,永不进 failures
nodes.rationale: 检查追加进 tools/cli/check-skill-consistency.mjs 现有的 reports 数组，永不进 failures、不动退出码——只报告不阻断，避免把来源登记变成新的质量门。
